# 8th Anniversary Scavenger Hunt

**Level:** 45 | **Maximum Level:** 125 | **Quest Type:** Task | **Repeatable:** Yes | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 45
**Maximum Level:** 125
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** Yes
**Can Be Shrouded?:** No
**Quest Type:** Task
**Group Size:** Solo
**Min. # of Players:** 1
**Max. # of Players:** 1

Anniversary events tend to run from mid-March to mid-April (sometimes to mid-May) each year. They are not available during the "off season".
For an overview and list of EverQuest Anniversary events, see this quest entry [quest=6782].
This quest begins with Tyla Filinav in The Nexus.
You say, 'Hail, Tyla Filinav'
Tyla Filinav says 'Have you come to help me in my collection ______?  There are quite a few items on my list and I'm worried about my chances to find them all.  Would you be [interested] in helping me find them all?'
You say, 'I am interested.'
Tyla Filinav says 'Perfect, here's the list of items I'm looking for and a bag to hold them in. Make sure you seal the bag once you've found them all and then return it to me.'
You receive a Lunar Collection Bag and A Lunar Clue Book, which reads:
1. Loo careflly a what you see. Find what yu are missin and use it to you advantge.
2. All the better to hear you with!
3. This is an unhappy little hallux.
4. You seek something basic.
5. You can't wring blood from a stone, but you might be able to grab what you need from this.
6. This hides not threats nor innuendo, but a sunny smile.
7. Walker on sunbeams, thing of nightmares.
8. This is concealed just a hop, skip or a jump away.
9. No eyes to see, but teeth in maw, this is found at the end of its paw.
10. This is skin and meat made of peat.
You are looking for:
1. The missing letters are K U T O G R A.  Rearrange these to spell "gor taku."  You are looking for A Collector's Crude Stone Idol - gor taku, Shadeweaver's Thicket.
2. A Collector's Sonic Wolf Ear - dire sonic wolf, The Tenebrous Mountains
3. A Collector's Grimling Toe - bone cracker, Grimling Forest
4. A Collector's Elemental Focus - elementals, The Twilight Sea
5. A Collector's Polished Stone - stonegrabber, Mons Letalis
6. A Collector's Sun Revenant Veil - sun revenant, The Scarlet Desert
7. A Collector's Lightcrawler Shell - lightcrawler, Dawnshroud Peaks
8. A Collector's Rockhopper Hide - greyhopper, Marus Seru
9. A Collector's Netherbian Claw - netherbian, Netherbian Lair
10. A Collector's Fungal Fiend Flesh - plerg fiends, Paludal Caverns
Red herring items (no known use) include:
A Collector's Tribal Belt, sambata, Dawnshroud Peaks
A Collector's Chk`Thk Horn, various Cht`Thk beetles, Shadeweaver's Thicket
A Collector's Ball of Mud, muck diggers, Paludal Caverns
Combine the ten items in your Lunar Collection Bag to craft a Sealed Lunar Collection Bag.  Hand this in.
You have fashioned the items together to create something new: Sealed Lunar Collection Bag.
Tyla Filinav says 'These are perfect! I can't believe you found them so quickly. Here take this as a reward for your help.'
You gain experience!!
You receive Lunar Fungus.Rewards:
- Lunar Fungus [item=67302]

# Help me Repair my Watch! (Level 55)

**Level:** 55 | **Maximum Level:** 125 | **Quest Type:** Task | **Repeatable:** No | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 55
**Maximum Level:** 125
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** No
**Can Be Shrouded?:** No
**Quest Type:** Task
**Group Size:** Solo
**Min. # of Players:** 1
**Max. # of Players:** 1

Find James the Watchmaker in the Plane of Knowledge next to the Halas stone.
He offers a task for each one of the hotzones introduced in the April 18, 2007 patch (listed here for reference).
You say, 'Hail, James the Watchmaker'
James the Watchmaker says, 'Hello there _____! Do you happen to have the [time]?'
You say, 'The time?'
James the Watchmaker says, 'Yes, the time of day. You see I usually keep a number of watches with me at all times so I always know what time it is but I recently [lost], well, all of them.'
You say, 'How were they lost?'
James the Watchmaker says, 'I lost them when I was travelling last week. I wanted to visit some of the places in Norrath that were special to me but I seemed to run into trouble everywhere I visited! And wouldn't you know it but everytime I stopped for a bit I managed to lose one of my [watches]!'
You say, 'Watches?'
James the Watchmaker says, 'That's what I said, watches! Are you hard of hearing? I don't suppose you would like to [look] for my watches? I hate not knowing what time it is! I'm sure I could find something in my backpack to interest you if you found one of my watches!'
You say, 'I will look for them'
This brings up a quest selector with several quests: One for each hotzone ranging from 20 to 65. Each has a very original name of: "Help me repair my watch! (Level X)", where X is between 20 and 65, in multiples of 5.
The task for 55th level:
Deliver 1 Silver Etched Gear #1 to James the Watchmaker. 0/1 Plane of Knowledge
Deliver 1 Silver Etched Reinforced Rod to James the Watchmaker. 0/1 Plane of Knowledge
Deliver 1 Silver Etched Gear #2 to James the Watchmaker. 0/1 Plane of Knowledge
Deliver 1 Silver Etched Gear #3 to James the Watchmaker. 0/1 Plane of Knowledge
These gears are dropped randomly in the Acrylia Caverns. They may be looted prior to retrieving the task.
Turn them in and choose from different back-slot items.Rewards:
- Expert Crafted Cloak of the Arcane [item=67679]
- Expert Crafted Cloak of the Attackers [item=67681]
- Expert Crafted Cloak of the Healers [item=67680]
- Expert Crafted Cloak of the Keen [item=67682]

James the Watchmaker says, 'That's what I said, watches! Are you hard of hearing? I don't suppose you would like to [look] for my watches? I hate not knowing what time it is! I'm sure I could find something in my backpack to interest you if you found one of my watches!'
You say, 'I will look for them'
This brings up a quest selector with several quests: One for each hotzone ranging from 20 to 65. Each has a very original name of: "Help me repair my watch! (Level X)", where X is between 20 and 65, in multiples of 5.

Worg Master Krellog can be located in the Merchant's rotunda of the Bazaar at -53.31, -53.54, 4.48.
You say, 'Hail, Worg Master Krellog'
Worg Master Krellog says 'Hail to yourself as well! Have ya seen me worg [mounts] yet? Quite the trusty steed if ya ask me, and a might better than those monstrous horses.'
You say, 'What mounts?'
Worg Master Krellog says 'Aye.. Worgs. Feisty and strong, but dun call them wolves if ya value yer hide. They're a wee bit sensitive about such things. If you have a mount now, I could be talked into some sort of [trade].'
You say, 'What kind of trade?'
Worg Master Krellog says 'Well, not really a trade. More like an [upgrade] to one of my CLEARLY superior worgs.'
You say, 'What kind of upgrade?'
Worg Master Krellog says 'Aye, an upgrade. What'cha do is put your old and busted bridle mount, along with the new hotness Worg mount into this here locker. Worgs are smart ya see. They'll run at whatever speed your old and busted bridle mount did. Not a bad deal I think!'
You receive: Locker of Lupine Linking
You can use this to create (or uncreate) worg mounts by combining the mount-summoning item and the bridle in the locker .
For example:
Mottled Worg Bridle +  Black Ornate Chain Bridle = Black Ornate Chain Worg Bridle
Many other bridles can be made, look at the quested items on the left to see a listing of which bridles you can combine. The recipes will be attached to the worg bridles listed as the rewards from the quest.Submitted by: Lord Elbribon L'Abattage, Tunare's Guilded Knights, TunareRewards:
- Black Chain Worg Bridle [item=70506]

# Tears of a God - Karana's Favor

**Level:** 15 | **Maximum Level:** 125 | **Quest Type:** Task | **Repeatable:** Yes | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 15
**Maximum Level:** 125
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** Yes

**Group Size:** Solo

Anniversary events tend to run from mid-March to mid-April (sometimes to mid-May) each year. They are not available during the "off season".
For an overview and list of EverQuest Anniversary events, see this quest entry [quest=6782].
This is an anniversary quest available only during anniversary season (a few weeks during March and April). It was introduced in 2009 as part of EverQuest's 10th anniversary.
This is one of 16 deity quests. For an overview of how rewards work and how these quests are linked with one another, see this writeup [quest=4843].
Below here are the details for this particular quest.
This task begins with Avatar of Karana in South Karana (-3692.78, -1810.55 towards middle of zone - east of Splitpaw; northwest of hermit).
You say, 'Hail, Avatar of Karana'
Avatar of Karana says 'Behold, mortal, I am Karana, Bringer of Storms. I find it appropriate to re-enter the mortal realm and gather new worshippers to my creed. To prosper among the other gods, I must extend my influence across the worlds, across the planes. You might hold the [key] to my success, and thus become the recipient of my favor.'
You say, 'The key?'
Avatar of Karana says 'I have set much work before my followers. For my power to grow, I require greater and greater amounts of worship from the mortal flock. For that to happen, they must be inspired by displays of my power. Thus, it is not an easy thing for me to display my powers in places where I have no worshippers, in places where it never rains. I have a [plan] to overcome that dilemma.'
You say, 'What plan?'
Avatar of Karana says 'I have given items and boons to my prominent followers among the mortals. If you will [accept] your fate as my loyal worshipper, I will tell you who you must follow.'
You say, 'I accept!'
Avatar of Karana says 'Very well, I am pleased with your piety. I shall look to be equally pleased by your service to me. Seek out Tober Grandim, in Blightfire Moors. He will give you the artifact that will conjure my power.'
You have been assigned the task 'Tears of a God - Karana's Favor'.
Karana needs you to give the people of certain parts of Norrath and the Planes reason to fear him, and start worshipping him, by making it rain in these places.
Hail Tober Grandim in Blightfire Moors
Speak with Tober Grandim in Blightfire Moors (by the Old Tower in the NW corner of the zone, /loc +879, +3094, is KOS to certain people but you can hail from a distance or while invis).
You say, 'Hail, Tober Grandim'
Your task 'Tears of a God - Karana's Favor' has been updated.
Tober Grandim says 'Ah, so Great Karana sends another willing acolyte! Perfect! I have a simple task for you, friend - as Karana has no doubt told you, he needs us to extend his power into places which never feel his power. That means it's up to us to make it rain in places that never receive a single raindrop, ever. The list of places this includes is quite a long one - but if you can make it rain in Everfrost Peaks, the Abysmal Sea, the Gulf of Gunthak, Corathus Creep, the Scarlet Desert, and the Plane of Knowledge, you will make our master very happy indeed.'
Receive True Karanite Rod of Rainfall (used to make it rain).
The following steps must be done in order:
Make it rain in Everfrost Peaks 0/1
Make it rain in Abysmal Sea 0/1
Make it rain in Gulf of Gunthak 0/1
Make it rain in Corathus Creep 0/1
Make it rain in Scarlet Desert 0/1
Make it rain in Plane of Knowledge 0/1
Hail Tober Grandim 0/1
You say, 'Hail, Tober Grandim'
Your task 'Tears of a God - Karana's Favor' has been updated.
Tober Grandim says 'Perfect, the rain has come to the driest of places! Karana be praised!'
Hail Avatar of Karana 0/1
You say, 'Hail, Avatar of Karana'
Your task 'Tears of a God - Karana's Favor' has been updated.
You have successfully earned the favor of the Stormbringer God, Karana!
Avatar of Karana says 'Your deeds have renewed my power in this world, already I can feel the mana from new worshippers adding into my spirit. I thank you, mortal, and give you this as a token of my appreciation.'
Reward:
Celebratory Firework Caster (if this is your first diety task)
Fireworks Focus of Karana

Avatar of Tunare is found in the Greater Faydark, a little ways west of Felwithe's Plane of Knowledge book.
You say, 'Hail, Avatar of Tunare'
Avatar of Tunare says 'Greetings, mortal. It has been far too long since I've set foot in Greater Faydark and beheld the cities of my beloved children. I still remember when many of them first set foot outside the city walls here, entranced and undoubtedly terrified by the [world] around them. (near Najena)

(near explorer tower, /loc 1900, -130)
- 8. Even a lazy wizard who sits all the time can find time to visit here! - Nektulos Forest
+455, -760, +37 Just north of the ruined wiz spires.

This task starts with Poison Masters in various cities and has a seven-day lockout timer. This is the second "Small Favor" task for rogues (the first being "A Small Favor - Endoc Cron").
You say, 'Hail, Poison Master Skuk'
Poison Master Skuk looks you up and down as if assessing your worth. 'Hello there, _____. It's good that you have come to me today. I was just saying to myself, Self, I said, who is worthy of this [opportunity] that I could offer? And now, here you are!'
You say, 'What opportunity?'
Poison Master Skuk nods. 'Yes, a most fantastic opportunity. I happen to have in my possession certain compounds. These compounds, when combined together, form [toxins] of various types. You might apply one of these toxics to a blade and if your hand happened to slip and the blade pierced the side of your enemy, why that enemy might begin to suffer in terrible agony. And that would be a terrible shame, wouldn't it?'
You say, 'What toxins?'
Poison Master Skuk laughs. 'You're interested? Of course you are! But I'm a businessman first and foremost. You would need to perform a [service] for me first. Consider it a small token of your appreciation for the gift that I will bestow upon you.'
You say, 'What service?'
Poison Master Skuk smiles grimly, the glint in his eye hinting at what a dangerous person you are dealing with. 'Here is your task, young one. Do not disappoint me. Never forget the tools of your craft - you must be invisible to detection or you will surely die. And you're no good to me dead!'
You have been assigned the task 'A Small Favor - Eldrith Tenk'.

It would be in your best interests to be hidden from view while undertaking this task as the Poison Master's informants report the Freeport Militia are on high alert.

# Nights of the Dead: Missing Costume Pieces

**Level:** 20 | **Maximum Level:** 125 | **Quest Type:** Task | **Repeatable:** Yes | **Monster Mission:** No

**Level:** 20

**Quest Type:** Task
**Group Size:** Solo
**Min. # of Players:** 1
**Max. # of Players:** 6

This is a shared task that was introduced in October 2005 and is available every year around Halloween. It scales according to your group's average level.
It's one of five tasks required to receive a Bone Mask of Horror [quest=5371] (illusion click item).
It begins with a dressed-up halfling in Kithicor Forest (location 1090, -570 against a log a little west of the Commonlands zone).
You say, 'Hail, a Dressed-Up halfling'
a Dressed-Up halfling says 'Oh no! I can't find the rest of my costume and I'm running late to our costume gathering. It was here just a little while ago and I can't seem to find it. Can you [help me find] it?'
You say, 'I'll help you find it'
a Dressed-Up halfling says 'You would help me? That is wonderful, I could use all the help that I can get. I don't want to be late. If you're late you miss out on all the candy. The last thing I remember was setting my cape and my fangs down over here next to the other [costumed vampire]. I walked away for no longer than it takes me to eat a mouthful of pie and when I turned around it was gone.'
You say, 'A costumed vampire?'
a Dressed-Up halfling says 'I have never seen him before but he had a good costume. He almost looked like a real vampire. Would you be [willing to search] for him to see if he has it?'
You say, 'I'm willing to search'
a Dressed-Up halfling says 'Wonderful, I'll keep looking around here. Please hurry back if you find them.'
You have been assigned the task 'Missing Costume Pieces'.
You have come across a Halfling dressed up for a costume gathering. He is searching for the rest of his costume before he is late for the festivities and has asked you to help him find it. The last thing he remembers was another person dressed up as a vampire. Search for the vampire and locate the rest of his costume.

# A Small Favor - Endoc Cron

**Level:** 45

This task starts with Poison Masters in various cities and has a seven-day lockout timer. This is the first "Small Favor" task for rogues (the second being "A Small Favor - Eldrith Tenk").
You say, 'Hail, Poison Master Skuk'
Poison Master Skuk looks you up and down as if assessing your worth. 'Hello there, _____. It's good that you have come to me today. I was just saying to myself, Self, I said, who is worthy of this [opportunity] that I could offer? And now, here you are!'
You say, 'What opportunity?'
Poison Master Skuk nods. 'Yes, a most fantastic opportunity. I happen to have in my possession certain compounds. These compounds, when combined together, form [toxins] of various types. You might apply one of these toxics to a blade and if your hand happened to slip and the blade pierced the side of your enemy, why that enemy might begin to suffer in terrible agony. And that would be a terrible shame, wouldn't it?'
You say, 'What toxins?'
Poison Master Skuk laughs. 'You're interested? Of course you are! But I'm a businessman first and foremost. You would need to perform a [service] for me first. Consider it a small token of your appreciation for the gift that I will bestow upon you.'
You say, 'What service?'
Poison Master Skuk smiles grimly, the glint in his eye hinting at what a dangerous person you are dealing with. 'Here is your task, young one. Do not disappoint me. Never forget the tools of your craft - you must be invisible to detection or you will surely die. And you're no good to me dead!'
You have been assigned the task 'A Small Favor - Endoc Cron'.
The poison master has asked you to perform a simple task and promised ample rewards for your service. Travel to East Freeport and resolve a small misunderstanding between the poison master and one Endoc Cron.
It would be in your best interests to be hidden from view while undertaking this task as the Poison Master's informants report the Freeport Militia are on high alert.
You receive a Distraction Device.
Enter East Freeport near Armor by Ikhtar via West Freeport near Grolagh's Forge and head north 0/1 (West Freeport)
Follow the "East Freeport" signs after zoning into West Freeport from the Plane of Knowledge and heading through the main city gate.
Sneak along the path precisely to avoid detection 0/1 (East Freeport)
Sneak along the path precisely to avoid detection 0/1 (East Freeport)
Sneak along the path precisely to avoid detection 0/1 (East Freeport)
Sneak along the path precisely to avoid detection 0/1 (East Freeport)
Sneak along the path precisely to avoid detection 0/1 (East Freeport)
Plant the bomb and hide 0/1 (East Freeport)
Use the distraction device (click it inside the wagon at your last update spot).
Run to Velith and Bardo while the guards are distracted and 'deal' with Endoc Cron 0/1 (East Freeport)
During the sneak stages, mystical paths will form. Endoc is guarded by two Militia Enforcers who will run out to the noise of the bomb. This will allow you to kill Endoc.
If you're too late (the timer is less then 5 minutes for them to run back but no idea on the exact time), they are back guarding Endoc. The enforcers hit for 96,000, so you're not likely to succeed unless they're distracted.

# Sacred Impressions (Variant B)

**Level:** 65 | **Maximum Level:** 125 | **Quest Type:** Task | **Repeatable:** No | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 65
**Maximum Level:** 125
**Monster Mission:** No

**Group Size:** Solo

This quest is identical for the following races and is given by the Artisan in your home city....
Dark Elf (Artisan Dosan Vis`Moor, Neriak Commons)
Dwarf (Artisan Yar Shiverbrow, South Kaladim)
Erudite (Artisan Goridon Telld`Mare, Erudin; Artisan Korzan Virimove, Paineel)
Froglok (Artisan Srekta Froreki, Mountains of Rathe)
Gnome (Artisan Vidi Cogsworthy, Ak'Anon)
High Elf (Artisan Elistar, Northern Felwithe)
Iksar (Artisan Sieeva Koan, East Cabilis)
(what other races?)
Dialogues with Artisan Vidi Cogsworthy:
You say, 'Hail, Artisan Vidi Cogsworthy'
Artisan Vidi Cogsworthy says 'Wha? Who are you? Go away! You're breaking my [concentration].'
You say, 'Concentration?'
Artisan Vidi Cogsworthy says 'Yes, I'm trying to concentrate on my calculations! You see, I discovered yesterday that based upon the gnomish arm-torso aspect ratio our current [armor] designs are actually patterned with suboptimal. . . Sub. . . Uh. . .. Blast! You've broken my concentration!'
You say, 'Armor?'
Artisan Vidi Cogsworthy says 'Yes, well, before you interrupted me I was trying to redesign Ak'Anon's armor patterns. I believe with my newest calculations, I can increase the efficiency of our designs by a significant margin. Assuming, of course, I can finish my calculations. It's hard to work with strangers running up and hailing me all day!' Vidi sighs and then continues, 'Tell you what, if you leave me alone, I'll make you a pattern book with my new designs. Would you be [interested] in that, or perhaps you're more interested in [symbols] I've been studying?'
You say, 'Symbols?'
Artisan Vidi Cogsworthy says 'These symbols when used in conjunction with my improved armor can improve them even more! If you're interested in them I have some [work] that you could do to earn some patterns for them.'
You say, 'What work?'
Artisan Vidi Cogsworthy says 'I need you to do a bit of exploration and gathering for me. The symbols need a certain amount of. . . Inspiration. I find that I do not have time to go out into the world and be inspired. I will give you an impression book that you can use to make impressions of certain patterns that you find out in the world. This book will magically take deep impressions or even just surface patterns. All of it is useful for inspiration. You may do as many of the tasks as you wish, but each requires a slightly different book.'
Dialogues with Artisan Elistar Vorann:
You say, 'Hail, Artisan Elistar Vorann'
Artisan Elistar Vorann says, 'Hello, Narah.  Welcome back to the fair city of [Felwithe].  You must tell me of your travels!'
You say, 'Felwithe'
Artisan Elistar Vorann says, 'While you were away, we have made much advancement.  Our trade alliance with Kaladim has secured us fresh mithril from their mines.  In the meantime, our artisans have been refining our armor [designs] in preparation for the new alloys.'
You say, 'designs'
Artisan Elistar Vorann says, 'Yes, our old designs relied too heavily on the stopping power of the materials used in the armor.  The new designs promote lighter, more flexible armor suits while providing the same amount of protection.  It's difficult to explain until you have worn a new suit yourself.  Would you be [interested] in these new armor patterns, or have you heard about the beneficial [symbols] I have discovered?'
You say, 'interested'
Artisan Elistar Vorann says, 'Very well.  To make you a pattern book, I'll need some zombie skin and darkbone marrow from the Estate of Unrest. I can use those to create the cover and ink for the book. I'll also need some of the battle beads from Crushbone to help bind the book and a rotting orc tooth to complete the ink. Bring me these things and the pattern book shall be yours.'
You say, 'symbols'
Artisan Elistar Vorann says, 'I have found a great many symbols that can be created and added to our new armor designs.  Once you placed these symbols on the armor the effect is nothing short of amazing.  The capabilities of the armor are improved beyond the sum of its parts.  Though there is a certain consistency to them, there is also a level of on the spot inspiration needed when making the symbols.  I will give you a book that you can use as a basis for the symbol patterns if you can prove your ability to seek inspiration.  Take as many of the tasks I offer you as you wish too.  During these tasks you will make impressions of certain things that you find in the impression book I will give you.  This magical book can make impression of objects with depth to them or just of the pattern on the surface of an object.'
You have been assigned the task 'Sacred Impressions'.
You receive a Sacred Impression Book.

Deliver the impression book to an artisan of your race 0/1 (ALL)
Return the impression book to the same artisan that gave you the quest.  You will receive the Sacred Book of XXX Culture appropriate to your race.

# Bugs in the Dirt

**Level:** 11 | **Maximum Level:** 11 | **Quest Type:** Task | **Repeatable:** No | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 11
**Maximum Level:** 11
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** No
**Can Be Shrouded?:** No
**Quest Type:** Task
**Group Size:** Solo
**Min. # of Players:** 1
**Max. # of Players:** 1

This is a medium sized task available from Khala Dun Erelk in Shar Vahl at location -455, -210, -190. It is known to be available at Level 11.
You say, 'Hail, Khala Dun Erelk'
Khala Dun Erelk says 'We are not the [task] masters, but simply the task providers. Those who have the desire to help Shar Vahl are placed into situations that best suit them. We prefer to think of it as a job for the soul and a journey through life.'
You say, 'What task do you have for me?'
One of the task choices given is "Bugs in the Dirt", a medium duration task with no timer.
You have been assigned the task 'Bugs in the Dirt'.
Enemies are always closer then you think, aren't they? That's exactly what you're going to learn on your journey today. They're much closer then you think so there's no time to waste. Just speak with Talsanna Deephaven, for information on exactly what you need to do get to the bottom of this dilemma.
Speak with Talsanna Deephaven 0/1 (Shadeweaver's Thicket)
Upon entering Shadeweaver's Thicket, the direction to this NPC will be marked on your compass. (She is at -1705, -3005, -200.)
You say, 'Hail, Talsanna Deephaven'
Talsanna Deephaven says 'Thanks for contacting me, ________. Your information on this matter has been most useful.'
By now you're beginning to understand the complexities of the situation aren't you? You're learning how problematic it can be to have to fight off your cohorts when they go bad. Sadly, you're going to have to take the road less travelled and kill 10 muck diggers,. Sometimes it's not the easiest way, but it's got to be done.
Kill 10 muck diggers 0/10 (Paludal Caverns)
(Glowing muck diggers count as well.)
Then there are times when those you slaughter weren't friends at all. It's a shame you had to be deceived like that, but those mongrels were causing too many problems. Now you are ready to face the threat of someone even closer than before. You need to kill 10 mud burrowers,. Wipe them out. In addition, they're holding very sensitive items that need to be recovered. While you're out cleaning up the mess, make sure you loot 4 Mud Burrower Carapace,.
Kill 10 mud burrowers 0/10 (Paludal Caverns)
Loot 4 Mud Burrower Carapace 0/4 (Paludal Caverns)
Once again you have proven that you can take the hard assignments and come out without a scratch. It's quite an accomplishment and it means you're almost done. Just deliver 4 Mud Burrower Carapace to Tesmina Boerak to finish everything off.
Deliver 4 Mud Burrower Carapace to Tessmina Boerak 0/4 (Shadeweaver's Thicket)
Upon entering Shadeweaver's Thicket, the direction to this NPC will be marked on your compass. (She is at -2820, -2730, -205.)
You really didn't know those who you were forced to slay, did you? No matter, they needed to go anyway, and you just happened to be the object of their demise. You did a clean, thorough job and you should be proud of the work you did. Here's a bit of a reward for the nightmares you're bound to have from this. Try to sleep soundly.
1 platinum, 3 gold, 6 copper

For an overview of Veil of Alaris pre-launch events, see this quest entry [quest=5343].
This is a pre-launch task leading up to the Veil of Alaris expansion, expected to be available only for a certain period of time ahead of VOA's launch.
It begins with a gnome named Chief Wood Engineer Gilanspring in the Steamfont Mountains. He's found in the far southeastern part of the Steamfont Mountains.
You say, 'Hail, Chief Wood Engineer Gilanspring'
Chief Wood Engineer Gilanspring says 'Hrmf.  I'm a busy gnome.  We've got a massive [project] under way here, and I really don't have time to spare.'
You say, 'What project?'
Chief Wood Engineer Gilanspring says 'You don't know about it? Well I don't have time to go into details.  You should talk to Olim, he likes to chat.  Then again, if you have that much spare time, maybe you could use it productively by [helping] out around here.'
You say, 'Helping, how?'
Chief Wood Engineer Gilanspring says 'We can always use hands doing the non-skilled stuff.  I think you'll be useful doing some of those [tasks].'
You say, 'What tasks?'
Chief Wood Engineer Gilanspring says 'Nothing too difficult for you, I hope.'
A task window pops up with three different tasks to choose from.
You have been assigned the task 'Scaffolding - Wide Planks'.
To move the project along, the engineers need to build scaffolding to allow the workers to reach it. And this time they need good planks to build with. Fontpines aren't strong enough to make scaffolding. Go talk to someone from the Wayfarers Brotherhood and see if they can spare some good planking.
Speak with a Wayfarers Brotherhood supplier 0/1 (Nedaria's Landing)
An NPC called "a Wayfarers Brotherhood supplier" spawns around the south part of the dock area of Nedaria's Landing (approximate area of 250, 1450).
You say, 'Hail, a Wayfarers Brotherhood supplier'
a Wayfarers Brotherhood supplier says 'Hello there. You say that you are looking for some sturdy, wide planks? We can provide those. I'd like to help out, but I can't just give away Brotherhood resources. If you can provide me with just a few items we need for extended shipboard excursions, I can certainly provide you a few planks.'
Kill some sunflowers and gather the odd fruit called Scarlet Lemon 0/5 (Scarlet Desert)
Mobs called "a sunflower" are found mostly in the dried riverbed area. This step will update as you kill them (no actual items involved).
NOTE: Only the person who gets the kill receives credit for it (whether grouped, or not).
Deliver 5 Tomato to a Wayfarers Brotherhood supplier 0/5 (Nedaria's Landing)
A Tomato can be purchased from Klen Ironstove in the Plane of Knowledge (CTRL+F, findable; location -70, 240).
Deliver 3 Flask of Orange Juice to a Wayfarers Brotherhood supplier 0/3 (Nedaria's Landing)
Flask of Orange Juice is produced with brewing (Trivial 35): 1x Water Flask + 2x Emerald Orange (makes 5x "Flask of Orange Juice").
NOTE: Emerald Oranges are foraged in the Emerald Jungle.
Upon doing the hand-ins, you receive 2x "Wide Jaggedpine Plank".
Deliver 2 Wide Jaggedpine Plank to any wood engineer 0/2 (Steamfront Mountains)

Chief Wood Engineer Gilanspring says 'You don't know about it? Well I don't have time to go into details.  You should talk to Olim, he likes to chat.  Then again, if you have that much spare time, maybe you could use it productively by [helping] out around here.'
You say, 'Helping, how?'
Chief Wood Engineer Gilanspring says 'We can always use hands doing the non-skilled stuff.  I think you'll be useful doing some of those [tasks].'
You say, 'Tasks?'
Chief Wood Engineer Gilanspring says 'Nothing too difficult for you, I hope.'
A task window pops up with two tasks to choose from.
You have been assigned the task 'Gondola Hull - Hull Planking'.
To move the project along, the engineers need to build scaffolding to allow the workers to reach it. And this time they need good planks to build with. Fontpines aren't strong enough to make scaffolding. Go talk to someone from the Wayfarers Brotherhood and see if they can spare some good planking.
Speak with a Wayfarers Brotherhood supplier 0/1 (Nedaria's Landing)
An NPC called "a Wayfarers Brotherhood supplier" spawns around the south part of the dock area of Nedaria's Landing (approximate area of 250, 1450).
You say, 'Hail, a Wayfarers Brotherhood supplier'
a Wayfarers Brotherhood supplier says 'Hello there. You say that you are looking for some sturdy, wide planks? We can provide those. I'd like to help out, but I can't just give away Brotherhood resources. If you can provide me with just a few items we need for extended shipboard excursions, I can certainly provide you a few planks.'
Kill some sunflowers and gather the odd fruit called Scarlet Lemon 0/5 (Scarlet Desert)
Mobs called "a sunflower" are found mostly in the dried riverbed area. This step will update as you kill them (no actual items involved).
Deliver 5 Tomato to a Wayfarers Brotherhood supplier 0/5 (Nedaria's Landing)
A Tomato can be purchased from Klen Ironstove in the Plane of Knowledge (CTRL+F, findable; location -70, 240).
Deliver 3 Flask of Orange Juice to a Wayfarers Brotherhood supplier 0/3 (Nedaria's Landing)
Flask of Orange Juice is produced with brewing (Trivial 35): 1x Water Flask + 2x Emerald Orange (makes 5x "Flask of Orange Juice").
NOTE: Emerald Oranges are foraged in the Emerald Jungle.
Upon doing the hand-ins, you receive 2x "Wide Jaggedpine Plank".
Create 2 Jaggedpine Hull Planks 0/2 (ALL)
Turn the planks into 2x "Jaggedpine Hull Plank" (one at a time) with the Recursive Clockwork Wood Reducer you received at the beginning of the task.
Deliver the Jaggedpine Hull Planks to any wood engineer 0/2 (Steamfont Mountains)
Chief Wood Engineer Gilanspring says 'Thank you for your help.'
Return the Recursive Clockwork Wood Reducer to any wood engineer 0/1 (Steamfont Mountains)
Chief Wood Engineer Gilanspring says 'Ah, good. This will be useful later, I'm sure.'

NOTE: THIS TASK IS NO LONGER AVAILABLE IN GAME.
For an overview of Veil of Alaris pre-launch events, see this quest entry [quest=5343].
This is a pre-launch task leading up to the Veil of Alaris expansion, expected to be available only for a certain period of time ahead of VOA's launch.
It begins with a gnome named Chief Smelting Engineer Whistle in the Steamfont Mountains. She's found in the far southeastern part of the Steamfont Mountains (location -1415, -1475, 5 -- in the back area of the work site).
You say, 'Hail, Chief Smelting Engineer Whistle'
Chief Smelting Engineer Whistle says 'Hello there.  I am Chief Smelter Whistle.  Basically that means that, for this project at least, I am responsible for all metal work.  That turns out to be a rather complicated task, for which I need a lot of [help].'
You say, 'Help?'
Chief Smelting Engineer Whistle says 'We have a lot of workers and engineers on the project, but there is a lot to do.  There is a lot more metal in a dirigible than most folks know.  And it has to be special metal in most cases.  We need agents to find what we need.  If you aren't here just to site see, then you might be interested in doing a few [tasks] for me.'
You say, 'What tasks?'
Chief Smelting Engineer Whistle says 'We have a lot that needs doing.'
A task window pops up with two tasks to choose from.
You have been assigned the task 'Guidance Systems - Front Fin'.
The great ship will have a fin on the front to help keep it stable. However, it will need to be strong and as light as possible. As you might have expected, the engineers seem to know exactly what they would like to use as materials. Heavy tubing can be found in the strongest and lightest form in the Plane of Innovation. Despite their names, the tin soldiers are not entirely made of tin, and they might have the tubing we need. Yttrium sheets should be strong enough and light enough to use as the web of the gin. Gather some ore for the engineers to make the fin with.
Find a Segment of Heavy Tubing to be repurposed for a guidance fin 0/1 (Plane of Innovation)
Most tin soldiers are found inside the factory of the plane (an Xanamech Nezmirthafen [quest=2207] kill may be required to open the front door), however there are a few spawns out front.
Collect 1 Small Brick of Yttrium Ore 0/1 (ALL)
Yttrium Ore is known to drop from Taskmaster shissar in the basement of Ssraeshza Temple, worms in the Akheva Ruins, named mobs in Grieg's End, thought horrors in the Deep, and sun revenants in the Grey.
Hand the Yttrium Steel Sheet to any smelting engineer 0/1 (Steamfont Mountains)
He needs the ore (not a sheet). On hand-in:
The smelting engineer was pleased with the items you brought.

# Happenings in Jaggedpine...

**Level:** 1 | **Maximum Level:** 125 | **Quest Type:** Quest | **Repeatable:** Yes | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 1
**Maximum Level:** 125
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** Yes
**Can Be Shrouded?:** No
**Quest Type:** Quest
**Group Size:** Solo
**Min. # of Players:** 1
**Max. # of Players:** 1

In Summer 2012, a few new NPCs and objects appeared in the northeast part of the Jaggedpine Forest (around location 1500, -1700).
Early Stages
If you hail Arben Leafsway while he's at the stone pillar:
Arben Leafsway wipes the sweat from his brow and looks up at you and smiles, 'Good day, _____. While it's not much to look at yet, you are standing on the site that will someday be Norrath's latest druidic monument. It will take a lot of material to construct this sacred relic, but I have full faith in the help of passing adventurers. If you happen to come across any rare stones, dolerite or the like, feel free to set them on the pillars and I'll get around to shaping them into form.'
If you hail him while he's at the campfire:
Arben Leafsway warms his hands by the fire and looks toward you, 'Greetings _____. I hope all is well with you. Me? I'm setting out to build a perfect replica of the great monuments that our people use for transport. If you happen to come across any rare stones, dolerite or the like, feel free to leave them by the pillars over there.'
Upon clicking the stone pillar next to Arben:
A lone pillar standing in this sacred grove. The design is familiar but it is not often that you see an unfinished monument such as this.
As you survey the unfinished monument you get the feeling that there will be a reason to return here when it is complete.
Sara Treewind is nearby:
You say, 'Hail, Sara Treewind'
Sara Treewind bows politely, 'A fine day to you, friend.'
Pemwenia Dagor is also nearby:
You say, 'Hail, Pemwenia Dagor'
Pemwenia Dagor raises her tearstained face from her hands and looks at you for a moment. She speaks in a soft whisper, 'It was... horrible... [horrible]...'
You say, 'Horrible?'
Pemwenia Dagor is visibly upset by your questioning. She begins shaking her head violently in a fit of emotion. Her words are louder, almost angry, '[They] have made their presence known again!'
You say, 'Who is they?'
Pemwenia Dagor looks to you then looks to the east. She says nothing then returns to her silent prayers.
Across the river is a sealed entrance to another area. Upon clicking the barricade in the blocked off area across the river, you see:
A barrier of living bark denies your entry.
Upon clicking the corpses scattered about:
Part of you wonders where the rest of the body ended up.
The mutilated torso drips blood onto the skeleton below it.
These bones appear to have been ripped out of the body that rests on the spikes above it.
The impaled body serves as a warning to anyone considering entry into the Unkempt Woods.
A discarded skeleton.
The lifeless hunk of flesh does not have any bite marks. Whatever killed this person was not interested in turning them into a meal.
Someone appears to be missing their legs.
Progress: Construction Started
Dolerite has finally been found through the "An Epic Request" tasks, and as turn-ins are made, the druid ring progresses in its build...
You say, 'Hail, Arben Leafsway'
Arben Leafsway says "A fine day indeed _____." He looks at the stone pillars and then turns back towards you. "Coming along nicely, wouldn't you agree? Anyway, if you happen to come across any pieces of dolerite, it would certainly help this project along. Just leave any pieces you come across by any of the pillars here and I'll get around to shaping them."
With the Small Dolerite Shard in your inventory, you can click on one of the pillars making up the would-be druid ring (this removes the Dolerite from your inventory):
You set the small shard of stone down next to the pillar. A small contribution to the ambitious project.
As you survey the unfinished monument you get the feeling that there will be a reason to return here when it is complete.
If you click the pillars without the Dolerite in your inventory, you see (depending on how far along the monument's construction has come):
The monument radiates with a faint semblance of power. Adventurers have been hard at work collecting the small bits of stone that make up this great site.
Or:
The familiar design of the ancient druidic monuments is recognizable just by the three pillars standing in this sacred grove.
Or:
Four stone pillars stand proudly in this sacred grove. It won't be long before the central pillar is raised and the monument takes a more recognizable form.
Progress: All Six Pillars Up
With all six pillars standing, if you hail him at the ring:
Arben Leafsway looks up with dark circles under his eyes. From the looks of it this halfling has not splept in weeks, 'Greetings, greetings to you, _____, I trust you are well? Can you believe it, the monument is nearly complete! This sacred ring, so close to the Shrine of Karana, it is a union of our people's most holy rites. Although I hate to beg, I must ask that if you come across any dolerite in your travels that you place it here by one of the pillars.'
If you hail him at the campfire:
Arben Leafsway looks up with wide-eyed excitement, his voice squeaks with intensity, 'I've hardly been able to sleep these last few days. The monument is nearly complete, oh to think of how I will be remembered in history as the architect of the new grand spires! You kind adventurers are wholly to thank for supplying the materials for this incredible work. Speaking of which, if you happen to come across any shards of dolerite, please leave them over by the pillars.'
Progress: Druid Ring Completed
With the druid ring completed, Arben Leafsway is known to say:
Arben Leafsway surveys the fine monument before looking up at you, 'I should have expected that this would not be a site people would use for transport, not that I am upset over the fact. There is little reason to travel here, it is dangerous, Surefall Glade is close by and has long been a site of transport attunement, still...' The halfling shakes his head quickly, 'No matter, I am no less proud of this amazing feat. You wouldn't believe the number of doubters I had, some going so far as claiming that there are spirits haunting these ruins!' The halfling cackles, 'Silly madmen and their rumors...'
Or:
Arben Leafsway warms his hands by the fireside. The halfling lets out a heavy sigh before speaking, 'It is quite a relief to have my great monument completed, but there is a strange emptiness in my life now, as if I have nothing to aspire to now...' The halfling stops and looks toward the sky, 'Perhaps I need a new project, something even more grand.' He smiles, 'Maybe exploring the Unkempt!' The halfling cackles gleefully and becomes lost in his own thoughts.
A barely visible NPC called "a familiar spirit" is next to the campfire:
You say, 'Hail, a familiar spirit'
a familiar spirit turns his head toward you but does not move. The figure seems confused that you can see him. He contemplates for a moment before speaking, 'So you see me, not many do.' He stops and looks around, 'Treasure your living moments and leave nothing undone in your life. You may not have tomorrow to share with the ones you love.'
a familiar spirit looks toward you and nods, 'Live your life with no regrets.'
Ring of Jaggedpine
Upon setting down a Small Dolerite Shard at a completed druid ring (if your server has it completed), you see:
You set the small shard of stone down next to the pillar. Reinforcement for the already finished project.
As you survey the impressive monument, a twinkling light catches your eye. You reach down to uncover a ring that has been carefully placed at the base of the pillar. Some long-lost heirloom to add to your collection.
You receive a "Ring of Jaggedpine" (1-hour reuse portal to Jaggedpine Forest -- note that this ring isn't always awarded and it isn't known under what conditions it would be):
Ring of Jaggedpine
MAGIC ITEM LORE ITEM NO TRADE
Slot: FINGER
Charges: Unlimited
Effect: Ring of Jaggedpine (Any Slot/Can Equip, Casting Time: 6.0)
Recast Delay: 3600 seconds
WT: 0.0 Size: TINY
Class: ALL
Race: ALLRewards:
- Ring of Jaggedpine [item=112799]

# Jaggedpine Recipes

**Level:** 1 | **Maximum Level:** 125 | **Quest Type:** Quest | **Repeatable:** No | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 1
**Maximum Level:** 125
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** No
**Can Be Shrouded?:** No
**Quest Type:** Quest
**Group Size:** Solo

Pergan Darkcloud is a merchant located at +1071, +2086 inside a building in the NW corner.
You say, 'Hail, Pergan Darkcloud'
Pergan Darkcloud says 'Hello there ______. My wife Nerdala and I have been in the business of making delicacies from the fresh ingredients available locally in our forest. Well, really my wife is the better cook but I'm pretty good at making [Noodles].'
You say, 'What noodles?'
Pergan Darkcloud says 'Noodles are pretty easy. They are just Flour, Egg and Water. It's [how you use the Noodles] after you make them that is important.'
You say, 'How can I use the noodles?'
Pergan Darkcloud says 'There's a whole bunch of things you can do with Noodles but the best thing you can do with them are to make [pastas] and [casseroles].'
You say, 'What pastas?'
Pergan Darkcloud says 'Well, you're going to need to talk to my wife about those recipes. She guards them pretty closely though so you may have to do some prying. Now what I am really good at is making Omelets!'
You say, 'What casseroles?'
Pergan Darkcloud says 'Well, you're going to need to talk to my wife about those recipes. She guards them pretty closely though so you may have to do some prying. Now what I am really good at is making Omelets!'
Nerdala Darkcloud is located next to her husband Pergan.
You say, 'Hail, Nerdala Darkcloud'
Nerdala Darkcloud says 'Hello ______, what can I help you with today?'
You say, 'I want pasta recipes.'
Nerdala Darkcloud says 'So it's pasta recipes you're looking for, huh? Well, I'm going to have to put you to work then. Are you [willing to run a small errand] for me?'
You say, 'I am willing to run a small errand.'
Nerdala Darkcloud says 'Well, that's nice of you. Here, take this Lunch Bag and bring it to Waldo Pinemyer. He is the steward of the Shrine of Karana on the far edge of forest. Take his lunch to him and bring the empty bag back to me and I'll let you have my pasta recipes.'
You receive a Lunch Bag [item=57033]. Go to Waldo Pinemyer [npc=9474] who's located +1290, -1552 by a tree in the northeast corner, just SW of the druid ring.
You say, 'Hail, Waldo Pinemyer'
Waldo Pinemyer says 'Eh... Huh... What do you want? Can't you just leave an old man to meditate in peace. Now go away.'
Give him the Lunch Bag.
Waldo Pinemyer says 'Huh... Who are you? Oh, you have my lunch. Thank you. Mmmm... This is great. Nerdala sure is an amazing cook.'
You receive an Empty Lunch Bag [item=57034]. Take this back to Nerdala.
Nerdala Darkcloud says 'Oh why thank you dear. Here's the pasta recipes as I promised.'
You receive Pasta For All [item=50570], a book giving out the recipes for Pasta with Cheese [item=15494], Pinemyer Pasta [item=15496], Vegetable Pasta [item=15501] and Pasta with Meat Sauce [item=15493].
You say, 'I want casserole recipes.'
Nerdala Darkcloud says 'Oh! You want to know my casserole recipes do you? Well I don't get the chance to get out much. A traveler from Faydwer came by and gave me this wonderful variety of sweet basil that grows wild in the Forest of Faydark some time ago. These recipes have been in my family for generations and I won't let just anyone have them but if you can bring me some more Faydwer Basil, I'll give you a copy of those recipes.'
Faydwer Basil [item=142684] is a ground spawn in Lesser Faydark, just north of the skeleton / undead monument. Hand one to Nerdala.
Nerdala Darkcloud says, 'Oh my, this smells wonderful! Here are the recipes I promised you. You seem to have a great love for cooking like myself. I have another set of recipes you may be interested in having. Have you ever tried a Stir Fry? They are so wonderfully light and refreshing. If you're [willing to do one more favor] for me, I'd be happy to share the recipe with you.'
You receive Hearty Casserole Dishes, a book giving out recipes for Anaconda Casserole [item=46657], Griffon Casserole [item=55071], Vegetable Casserole [item=54031] and Cheesy Anaconda Casserole [item=15474].
You say, 'willing to do one more favor'
Nerdala Darkcloud says, 'That's the spirit! Anything for a good recipe, I always say. I've heard tales of a very rare variety of mushroom that grows only in the deepest depths on the continent of Odus. I'd love to try to make something with those. If you happen run across any Deep Odus Mushrooms I'd happily trade them for the secret of making Stir Frys.'
Deep Odus Mushroom [item=109792] is a ground spawn in Toxxulia Forest west of the druid ring. Hand one to Nerdala.
Nerdala Darkcloud says, 'You did it! Wow, they're so large I can't wait to make something with these! Well, I suppose I have to give you my recipe now. Don't share this recipe with anyone else though!'
You gain party experience!
You receive Nerdala's Secret Stir Fry [item=142686], a book giving out recipes for Jaggedpine Stir Fry [item=29570], Griffon Stir Fry [item=15486] and Anaconda Stir Fry [item=29569].
If you give Nerdala's Secret Stir Fry to Pergan, he takes it :
Pergan Darkcloud says, 'Amazing, you managed to pry it out of her! Ok, here are the secrets to making my special Omelets. Don't tell her you gave me the recipe or she'll kill me.'
You receive Pergan's Favorite Omelets [item=142721], a book giving out recipes for Omelette du Fromage [item=15491], Meat Lover's Omelet [item=142720] and Ranger's Omelet [item=15500].Submitted by: TobynnRewards:
- Hearty Casserole Dishes [item=142685]
- Nerdala's Secret Stir Fry [item=142686]
- Pasta for All [item=50570]
- Pergan's Favorite Omelets [item=142721]

# Jaggedpine Druid Tunic

**Level:** 42 | **Maximum Level:** 130 | **Quest Type:** Quest | **Repeatable:** No | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 42
**Maximum Level:** 130
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** No
**Can Be Shrouded?:** No
**Quest Type:** Quest
**Group Size:** Solo

Nolan Greenwood may be found at /waypoint 1052, 1825, -9.73 .
You say, 'Hail, Nolan Greenwood'
Nolan Greenwood gives a gentle nod to ______, 'Greetings. I am Nolan Greenwood, warder of the Jaggedpine and retainer of our [ancient ways]. The recent introduction of [outsiders] whose faith and loyalties mimic our own toward The Rainkeeper has led to the rebirth of a long lost excitement and use for my talents, thus my presence here today. Usually, I would not be so easily found for when presented with the choice, for I prefer the sanctuary of the open forest to the confining walls of my room here at Fort Jaggedpine.'
You say, 'What ancient ways?'
Nolan Greenwood says 'As with any culture, my friend, there are countless established ways of life, worship, law, and order. It would be impossible for me to explain all of our ancient ways in a single conversation -- and even more impossible would it be for you to understand them. You must experience and [accept them as your own] to fully understand.''
You say, 'I accept them as my own.'
Nolan Greenwood raises a brow and gives a gentle, warm smile to ______'s declaration, 'I see, and am very pleased to know that your interest has grown and your heart is opened to know the path of The Rainkeeper. As I retain the laws and order of nature that we of the Jaggedpine have sworn ourselves to, I will be more than willing to give you what words I can to guide you toward true discovery of what it means to be of The Rainkeeper's service and pledge. The rest shall be taught through your own experience in these [trials].'
You say, 'What trials?'
Nolan Greenwood says 'To show your devotion to the natural world and strengthen your abilities to protect it, you must engage in a symbiotic relationship with nature. As you give your devotion and one day your life to the natural world, it will equally provide the [tools] that will aid you to execute the duties and protection you have pledged to uphold.'
You say, 'What tools?'
Nolan Greenwood says 'Sustenance, shelter, and the necessities that we must have to survive are all provided by the world that we must protect. The wilderness will also lend its spiritual force to you, and it is the fullest potential of that spiritual force that I can see you and many other druids have yet to truly harness. Do not think that we reave these things from nature -- for as I said, our relationship must be mutual. If you invest the time and prayer to [ask of her], she shall provide the rest to these needs most willingly -- as a mother would her beloved child.'
You say, 'What shall I ask of her?'
Nolan Greenwood says 'These questions are not of the vocal expression, my friend. To request nature's aid, you must go in-search of that aid. In that search, you will provide unto her nothing less than a service equal to what it is you seek. My beloved daughter, Cheyloh, and [I shall guide you] through this quest.'
You say, 'How shall you guide me?'
Nolan Greenwood says 'I will give you the guidance of words and my knowledge of the details pertaining to your tasks. My experience and talents in the ways of making proper and the most efficient use of that which nature will grant you in gratitude of your service to her shall be at your disposal as necessary and appropriate. The first of your tasks will be to acquire and return to me two items -- [Silver Griffon Feathers] and a [Jade Studded Rawhide Tunic].''
You say, 'What Silver Griffon Feathers?'
Nolan Greenwood says 'There is a beast known as the Silver Griffon whom lurks in the darkest of shadows cast by Luclin's light. Although this creature was born of those that are natural, the Silver Griffon himself is not. Once a great and powerful creature of the Karana Plains, the beast known as the Silver Griffon was killed and its spirit corrupted by the priests of The Plaguebringer when their scourge was brought upon those plains not too long past. Put this creature to rest and from its ethereal wings, bring me its silver feathers.''
You say, 'What Jade Studded Rawhide Tunic?'
Nolan Greenwood says 'As the Qeynos faithful of The Rainkeeper have come to us, we have sent some of our most adept brothers and sisters to them as an act of good faith in hope that our ways would be exchanged. One such adept is Jhaya Wyndrunner. She, like myself, is a keeper of our ways -- a former apprentice of mine, in fact, and a master in the arts of weaving. Speak to her about the Jade Studded Rawhide Tunic and she will give you further guidance on how you may acquire it.''
Jhaya can be found in Surefall Glade at /waypoint -319, -476 .
You say, 'Hail, Jhaya Wyndrunner'
Jhaya Wyndrunner gives a gentle, warm smile to ______, 'Hello, my friend. I trust that you are fairing well this day for I. . . oh, never mind that. I do not mean to be rude and impose my [troubles] to you, my friend. Please, forgive my lack of manners. It is a pleasure to make your acquaintance, of course, but I must return to my duties -- [time is so precious]. . . too precious'.
You say, 'What is the Jade Studded Rawhide Tunic?'
Jhaya Wyndrunner gives a gentle, almost musical chuckle of delight, 'Nolan Greenwood must be quite excited to have his great talents be of interest and use once again. I will be more than willing to aid you in fulfilling my former mentor and dearest friend's task of you. Unfortunately, I am at a loss for the supplies that are necessary to aid you properly and my duties keep me safe in the Glade. I will need you to bring me two specific [items] and I will be happy to sew them into the tunic.'
You say, 'What items?'
Jhaya Wyndrunner says 'The items I require for this tunic will not be easy to acquire, my friend and I do apologize for the turmoil that you will likely plunge yourself into to fulfill this task -- but as is the way of those whom defend the natural world. The two items I need of you are the [Pouch of Polished Jade Stones] and a [Black Rawhide Tunic].''
You say, 'What Pouch of Polished Jade Stones?'
Jhaya Wyndrunner says 'Our artisans of the Jaggedpine pride themselves on the beauty and quality of their products. The jade stone has become a sort of a symbol to those of us in the Jaggedpine and it is used almost exclusively to decorate all of our powerful tools. Unfortunately, many others have found the potential of these stones and have begun to reave them from us and our craftsman have been too occupied with the recent events to make any great supply of these items. You must [find] one of the [stolen pouches].''
You say, 'Where can I find the stolen pouches?'
Jhaya Wyndrunner says 'With the creation of the passageway in Blackburrow to the Jaggedpine Forest, many of the poachers that are native to Qeynos soil have secretly made their way into our woodlands. They maliciously destroy our beautiful and sacred beasts solely for the purpose of monetary profit. We were not prepared to encounter such individuals and these thieves raided many of our establishments at Fort Jaggedpine. The artisans were not spared these barbarous acts and many of our precious stones were stolen. I know the name of the one who may have these stones -- Greshvoule.''
You say, 'Who is Greshvoule?'
Jhaya Wyndrunner glares at the mention of the name, 'Greshvoule was one of many poachers to invade our forest after the construction of the subterranean passageway. He is a very cunning thief and a warrior not to be trifled with. He. . . killed one of our artisans and a dear friend of mine, Callisa, who specialized in the art of carving and polishing these jade stones. One of the rangers native to the glade graced me with his favor and found that the barbarian known as Greshvoule is hiding in Permafrost, trying to escape proper justice for his crimes against the glade. If you could find him and avenge the wrongs committed against my dear friend and the glade, I would be eternally grateful.'
You say, 'What is the Black Rawhide Tunic?'
Jhaya Wyndrunner says 'That is an item that you must forge with your own skills, my friend. We of the Jaggedpine use the resources that nature allows us to the fullest extent and it is our law that when we embrace nature's gifts, that the one whom has gained those gifts must use their own hands and work to earn that gift -- for she has granted it to you, and you alone. I can tell you [how to make the Black Rawhide Tunic] and perhaps make this task a bit easier for one as new to our ways as yourself, my friend.'
You say, 'How can I make a Black Rawhide Tunic?'
Jhaya Wyndrunner says 'To make the tunic, you will need to acquire the appropriate materials. These materials are a [Cured Panther Hide] and [Whisps of Potameid Hair]. These two items, if properly sewn together, will make the Black Rawhide Tunic that you will need to further your task to Nolan. But be wary, my friend. The tailoring of this item is not for the inept of this skill. You must master the thread and needle to be successful in sewing the tunic.''
You say, 'What Cured Panther Hide?'
Jhaya Wyndrunner says 'The poachers that have invaded our forest are far from having any mutual arrangement with the world they carelessly reave from. One such poacher, Elishia Blackguard of the Blackguard family is known to 'specialized' in furs. She has been seen skinning the corpses of our forest panthers and despite how despicable her actions are she truly is worthy of her reputation. Likely if you find her, you will find a Flawless Panther Hide. Once you have retrieved the hide and the [gifts of the forest], take the items to my brother, Lerian, who you will find here in the glade.''
You say, 'What gifts of the forest?'
Jhaya Wyndrunner says 'The great pines in our forest are a constant and generous source of sap. You can harvest this sap without harming the woodlands by foraging. The second gift is the Dew of the Hatchling, which you shall also find without turmoil as the forest will freely give it if you take the time to seek it out.'
You say, 'What Whisps [sic] of Potameid Hair?'
Jhaya Wyndrunner says 'When the folk of the Jaggedpine came to the forest many centuries ago, the Potameides and other nymphs were plentiful across the whole of Norrath's then untainted wilderness. The Potameides assisted our ancestors, teaching them how to harvest safely from the forest and had given us the gifts of their spiritual essence with their blessings. This essence was essential in developing the powerful tools that Nolan has you questing for now. But, as the time passed and civilizations grew, these spirits of nature perished when the nature they are bound to were interrupted with the construction of these cities. The Potameides of the Hatchling are the only naiads of Norrath that any know to still exist. It is this extinction that they face which has made acquiring this essence so [trying].''
You say, 'Why is it trying?'
Jhaya Wyndrunner says 'The Potameides have become. . . hostile toward any mortal that dares to tread in their territory. This hostility is understandable, but it is not for natural reasons. Our neighbors to the north made a pact with Queen Nhyalia of the Hatchling, and the Potameides abide by this pact -- to destroy any that dares to cross the river. Some of us believe that they have become corrupt by abiding mortal requests and becoming pawns to our feral, wildling neighbors. Unfortunately, one must use force to retrieve the essence. But, do not be discouraged, my friend. The destruction of the Potameides is temporary, for as long as the river itself remains untainted, each spirit will return to guard her sacred home. You must seek out the Potameid Maidens, whose hair will hold the essence you need.''
Upon giving the Flawless Panther Hide, Jaggedpine Sap, and Dew of the Hatchling to Lerian Wyndrunner:
Lerian Wyndrunner studies the hide carefully -- using his eyes, fingertips, and sense of smell to be sure that it is indeed of the panthers native to the Jaggedpine forest. Accepting the true identity of the hide, Lerian removes a small vial of clear oil and smears it across the flawless midnight fur. He then retrieves the seeds from the small pouch given to him by ______, and begins to chant lowly and softly in his ancient druidic tongue. The seeds begin to sprout, growing at an unnatural pace from the nourishing oil. The fern imbeds itself in a beautiful design upon the hide as they grow -- their roots and the thin, delicate vines rendering the flora secure in its place. Lerian then offers the hide to ______, 'You will need to seek out one other item -- the Blackened Mithril Boots from the kobold priest in Solusek's eye. Once you have the boots, you will need a master's knowledge of tailoring to carefully fit this hide over the boots before returning them to Cheyloh.'
Your faction standing with Residents of Jaggedpine could not possibly get any better.
Your faction standing with Jaggedpine Treefolk could not possibly get any better.

Combine 1 Wisps of Potameid Hair and 1 Cured Panther Hide in a tailoring container to make a Black Rawhide Tunic (trivial unknown).
Upon giving the Pouch of Polished Jade Stones and Black Rawhide Tunic to Jhaya Wyndrunner:
Jhaya Wyndrunner says 'Excellent, my friend! Well done indeed. These are exactly what I needed to make the tunic Nolan has requested of you. And. . . thank you for avenging my dear, departed friend. She shall be missed, and it is in her memory that I give you the Jade Studded Tunic. Go now, my friend. Nolan awaits and I am sure that he will be most impressed with your success thus far'.'

Secalna Galnor is located at +114, -80, -157.
You say, 'Hail, Secalna Galnor'
Secalna Galnor says 'Hello, ______. I hear you are an up-and-coming new adventurer. Your future looks bright. Won't you stay a moment and learn what I have to teach?  If you miss your friends in the Mines of Gloomingdeep it might be possible for me to [send] you back there.'
A task window appears with a number of tutorial tasks.
You have been assigned the task 'The Bazaar: Tricks of the Trade'.
Speak to Nebbo Watzet near the entrance to the bazaar 0/1 (Plane of Knowledge)
Nebbo is just outside the Bazaar to the left of the ramp going up to the door at /loc 259.41, 1428.41, -125.25.
You say, 'Hail, Nebbo Watzet'
Nebbo Watzet says 'Why what a pleasure to meet you, ______. It's been quite some time since I've seen such an honest face around here. I can tell from your demeanor that you would never, ever, under any circumstances enter into business with your dear friend, only to cast him aside in an effort to line your own pockets with platinum!' The tense gnome takes a moment to suck in a deep, calming breath before continuing with a forced smile, 'But I can trust you, can't I? You're nothing like that no-good [Nermin]...'
You say, 'Nermin?'
Nebbo Watzet says 'Nermin and I were grand adventurers, collecting treasures from the far reaches of Norrath. We grew tired of merchants in town offering us insulting sums for our hard-earned trinkets, so we decided to set up shop as traders in the bazaar. We were a powerhouse from the beginning! Adventurers from all over came to the bazaar to browse our wares. No one could beat our prices! But then something unexpected [happened]...'
You say, 'What happened?'
Nebbo Watzet says 'Nermin got greedy, you see. He didn't like having to split the profits, so he started trading on his own in the bazaar. My business began to slow the moment he set up shop, and has been suffering ever since. I'm not sure what tricky tactics he's using, but I just know that gnome is up to no good! I don't suppose, as my new friend, you'd be willing to do me a [favor]?'
You say, 'What favor?'
Nebbo Watzet says 'My former business partner has instructed all of his employees to not speak or sell to me. I need an unfamiliar face to head into the [bazaar] and see what Nermin is up to. You're interested in a little industrial espionage, right?'
You say, 'The bazaar?'
Your task 'The Bazaar: Tricks of the Trade' has been updated.
Nebbo Watzet says 'Splendid! The entrance to the bazaar is right behind me. Nermin conducts his business in the main hall. He shouldn't be hard to find.'
Talk to Nermin within the bazaar 0/1 (The Bazaar)
LOADING, PLEASE WAIT...
You have entered The Bazaar.
Nermin is straight from zone in, next to the center pillar in the center room, at /loc 12.41, -13.71, 2.28.
You say, 'Hail, Nermin'
Nermin says 'Welcome to the bazaar, ______. Here you'll find the largest selection of buyers and traders, including my own thriving [business], Nermin's Novelties.'
You say, 'Business?'
Your task 'The Bazaar: Tricks of the Trade' has been updated.
Nermin says 'I buy and sell a wide variety of goods at a bargain price. If you're looking to sell your goods, be sure to visit my [buyer], EIan, in Blue Griffin Hall. He'll always give you a fair price. If you're looking to [purchase] items, my [trader] Helena in Red Dragon Hall won't be undersold!'
You say, 'Buyer?'
Nermin says 'Sometimes the bazaar may not have the item you want, or it may be listed for a price that's out of your budget. In this case, it's a good idea to barter. Buyers set up their stalls in the Blue Griffin Hall with a list of items they'd like to purchase, and the price they're willing to pay. Anyone can use the barter system to sell their items to a buyer.'
A pop up window titled Bartering appears with more details.
You say, 'Trader?'
Nermin says 'Setting yourself up as a trader is simple, but first you'll need to purchase a Trader's Satchel from Merchant Tekrama. Place all the items you wish to sell inside a trader's satchel, but don't forget to set your prices before you begin trading!'
A pop up window titled Becoming a Trader appears with more details.
You say, 'Purchase?'
Nermin says 'Traders set up their stalls in the Red Dragon Hall, selling everything from hand-crafted potions, to items they've found during their adventures. You can sort through all the items placed for sale, and when you've found an item you want to buy, you can head directly to the trader within the bazaar to make your purchase.'
A pop up window titled Buying Items in the Bazaar appears with more details.
Find the teleporter to Blue Griffin Hall 0/1 (The Bazaar)
Go up the hallway marked with the blue griffin flags and onto the teleport pad.
Your task 'The Bazaar: Tricks of the Trade' has been updated.
Find and speak to Elan 0/1 (The Bazaar)
Elan is found up the first hall on the right after teleporting, at /loc 1390.47, 1099.58, 33.16 in the (blue) Diamond room as marked on map.
You say, 'Hail, Elan'
Elan says 'Greetings, ______. My name is Elan, and I'm a [buyer].'
You say, 'What's a buyer?'
Elan says 'What's a buyer you ask? Well, it's pretty simple actually. If there are items I am looking to purchase, I set up a buyer stall within the bazaar. Here, I can list what items I am looking to purchase and set the price I am willing to pay for them. People can then sell me those [items] by visiting my stall.'
You say, 'Items?'
Your task 'The Bazaar: Tricks of the Trade' has been updated.
Elan says 'Nermin currently has me buying up as many bone chips as I can get my hands on for 3 silver each, and not a copper more! I'm on my break right now though, but you should browse through the other buyers here, using the [barter] system. They may be looking to purchase an item you have.'
You say, 'Barter?'
Elan says 'The barter system allows you to search through all the buyers within the bazaar who are looking to buy goods. You can see if anyone is buying items you have in your inventory. It's a great way to earn a few coins.'
A pop up window titled Bartering appears with more details.
Find the teleporter to Red Dragon Hall 0/1 (The Bazaar)
Go down the hallway marked with the red dragon flags and onto the teleport pad.
Your task 'The Bazaar: Tricks of the Trade' has been updated.
Find and speak with Helena 0/1 (The Bazaar)
Helena is found up the first hall on the right after teleporting, /loc 1390.83, -714.13, 33.16, in the (red) Diamond room as marked on the map.
You say, 'Hail, Helena'
Helena says 'Hello, ______. My name is Helena, and I'm a [trader].'
You say, 'Trader?'
Helena says 'As a trader, I fill up my trader [satchels] with items that I want to sell. I then set the price for each item, and begin trading once I am in Red Dragon Hall. Nermin has me selling bone chips for 3 platinum each, but I recently ran out of stock! I'm waiting on Elan to deliver another stack.'
Your task 'The Bazaar: Tricks of the Trade' has been updated.
You say, 'satchels'
Helena says 'In order to sell items, they have to be placed in trader satchels. You can buy a satchel from Merchant Tekrama in the main room of the bazaar.'
A pop up window titled Bartering appears with more details.
Return to Nebbo Watzet in the Plane of Knowledge 0/1 (Plane of Knowledge)
LOADING, PLEASE WAIT...
You have entered The Plane of Knowledge.
You say, 'Hail, Nebbo Watzet'
Nebbo Watzet says 'Finally, you've returned! So tell me, what did you [find] out about Nermin's business tactics?'
You say, 'What did I find?'
Your task 'The Bazaar: Tricks of the Trade' has been updated.
You have helped Nebbo Watzet discover his rival's business tactics while learning how the bazaar works.
Nebbo Watzet says 'He has his buyer acquiring bone chips at a low price, and his trader reselling them for a hefty profit? What a brilliant idea! Why didn't I think of that? Oh well, two can play at this game. Here's a token of my appreciation for all your help.'

**Maximum Level:** 125

This task begins with Skal Nethus (map) in the Plane of Knowledge. He's an Erudite found at location -320, 1200, -111 (close to Franklin Teek, just east of the Guild Lobby).
You say, 'Hail, Skal Nethus'
Skal Nethus says 'Adventurer, you have not seen any strange apparitions in your [dreams] lately, have you?'
You say, 'I haven't had any strange dreams'
Skal Nethus says 'Thank the gods! Then it is not too late! After my last, uh, mishap with Dungeon Rot, I went on a walking [journey] across Norrath, to clear my head and think of my next venture. Eventually night found me in the Feerrott, and I laid my head down upon a mossy statue to [sleep].'
You say, 'What journey?'
Skal Nethus says 'Ah, you're interested in my journey? Well, it's quite a story. While traveling, I came across a dusty old book. It tells the story of a legendary [flower], the Udumbara, that blooms once every three-thousand years.'
You say, 'What flower?'
Skal Nethus says 'That's right! A natural artifact so powerful, it is rumored the Gods themselves limited its recurrence in Norrath. But there is a catch: the alchemist who wrote this book found a way to grow the flower artificially, though it is no easy [task].'
You say, 'What task?'
Skal Nethus says 'Hmm... where to start? You'll have to travel to many dangerous areas of Norrath and recover a series of [artifacts], some natural, some crafted by unknowns. Once you have, come talk to me and I'll instruct you on what to do with them. Be very careful though, mysterious natural forces are at work and will be looking for these artifacts too!'
You say, 'I'll find the artifacts!'
Skal Nethus says 'Very well, here is a list of where you can look for them. Good luck to you!'
You have been assigned the task 'Udumbara, the flower of legend'.
All items in this task are found in the hot zones that were introduced on June 19, 2013.
Mobs in these zones will randomly morph into a treant (does not change its name or abilities; only changes form into a small green treant). When that happens, that mob will drop the item.
NOTE: It's possible (not confirmed) that only specific mob types have a chance to morph into a treant. It's also possible (again not confirmed) that the mob type can vary by the day (or some period of time). Update to the NOTE: looking at bestiary entries of the past few years it really looks like these are zone randoms and not specific NPC (again not confirmed)
All items are pre-lootable.
- Deliver 1 Soul of the Wilderness to Skal Nethus 0/1 (Plane of Knowledge)
This is found in Warsliks Wood in the cave that is the entrance to Crypt of Dalnir. (kill "an iksar lookout"; "a skulking brute", and various scaled wolves for the Soul of the Wilderness).
- Deliver 1 Scorching Light of the Heavens to Skal Nethus 0/1 (Plane of Knowledge)
This is found in Marus Seru (confirmed from "A Hand of Seru"; "a Greyhopper"; "a Crumbling Stonegrabber"; "a Weathered Stonegrabber").
- Deliver 1 Alpine Light of the Heavens to Skal Nethus 0/1 (Plane of Knowledge)
This is found in the Frontier Mountains (confirmed from "a burynai cenobite"; "a mountain giant tump"; "a Sarnak knight"; "a mountain giant brae").
- Deliver 1 Water of Plenty to Skal Nethus 0/1 (Plane of Knowledge)
This is found in the Dawnshroud Peaks (confirmed from "A Rockhopper", "a wolf"; yellow fungus mobs).
- Deliver 1 Tears of Karana to Skal Nethus 0/1 (Plane of Knowledge)
This is found in Jaggedpine Forest (confirmed from "a black panther", "a black pinewolf"; "a giant anaconda"; "a grey pinewolf"; "a greenwood grizzly").
- Deliver 1 Ashes of Kunark to Skal Nethus 0/1 (Plane of Knowledge)
This is found in the Burning Woods (confirmed from "a forest giant ancient", "a forest giant arbor", "a forest giant verdant", "a sarnak avenger", "a sarnak knight", "a tatterback gorilla").
- Deliver 1 Ancient Compost Box to Skal Nethus 0/1 (Plane of Knowledge)
This is found in Corathus Creep (confirmed from "a corathus squirmer", "a slithering corathus" and "a creep reaper").
- Deliver 1 Blood Infused Soil to Skal Nethus 0/1 (Plane of Knowledge)
This is found in the Bloodfields in the circular rooms that are at the zones to City of Dranik and Dranik's Scar. (confirmed from "a dragorn commoner"; "a dragorn peon", "Sentry of Kaavi").
- Deliver 1 Infrangible Bottle to Skal Nethus 0/1 (Plane of Knowledge)
This is found in Undershore (confirmed from "an Illsalin soldier", "a witheran gnasher", "a splorgath", "a basilisk").
- Deliver 1 Flawless Air of the Plane to Skal Nethus 0/1 (Plane of Knowledge)
This is found in the Plane of Air, otherwise known as "Eryslai, the Kingdom of Wind" (confirmed from "a fearsome stormrider", "a stormrider lightningclaw", phoenix mobs and "A Nilborien Servant").
- Deliver 1 Sunlight Prism Box to Skal Nethus 0/1 (Plane of Knowledge)
This is found in Wall of Slaughter (confirmed from "girplans along the path to Anguish").
- Deliver 1 Serene Light of the Heavens to Skal Nethus 0/1 (Plane of Knowledge)
This is found in Oceangreen Hills (confirmed from "a Blackburrow lurker"; "a zombie bombardier").
- Deliver 1 Antipodal Light of the Heavens to Skal Nethus 0/1 (Plane of Knowledge)
This is found in the Hills of Shade (confirmed from "a Kirathas villager"; "thorned mulch").
- Deliver 1 Damp Fog of the Field to Skal Nethus 0/1 (Plane of Knowledge)
This is found in the Old Bloodfields (confirmed from "nocs and kyvs").
- Deliver 1 Blood of Lunanyn to Skal Nethus 0/1 (Plane of Knowledge)
This is found in the Valley of Lunanyn (confirmed from the "reega" mobs in the mephit tunnels).
- Deliver 1 Portable Greenhouse of Thule to Skal Nethus 0/1 (Plane of Knowledge)
This is found in the Grounds (confirmed from "a souring treant"; rotdogs; peponnites).
- Ask Skal what comes next! 0/1 (Plane of Knowledge)

Outstanding! I cannot believe you were able to recover all of them. Well, almost all of them. I was not entirely honest with you. This is the final item you'll need. I was keeping it in case you would not return. Take it, and take this recipe: follow it to the letter and you shall have Udumbara!

# Ssraeshzian Chain Armor

**Level:** 45 | **Maximum Level:** 125 | **Quest Type:** Task | **Repeatable:** Yes | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 45
**Maximum Level:** 125
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** Yes

**Min. # of Players:** 1
