Norx Blackheart (map) is an Iksar found in The Overthere. He's at 315, 700, 35 (on a hill overlooking the western part of the gorge in the middle of the zone).
You say, 'Hail, Norx Blackheart'
Norx Blackheart says 'Greetings.  I am a simple scholar, seeking a fuller understanding of this world and my place in it.  You are, of course, here to learn about your [enemy], know their [history], and what drove them [away] from this [place] long ago, yes?  Or are you a simpleton merely interested in [armor]?'
You say, 'Tell me about the enemy'
Norx Blackheart says 'Of course, I refer to the Shissar, a race that oppressed even the mighty Iksar at the peak of their power.  Thousands of years ago they [ruled] this continent, until their hubris brought about their [demise].'
You say, 'What about their history? How did they rule?'
Norx Blackheart says 'They ruled their empire of blood from the grand city of [Chelsith], built by Iksar slaves and powered by their dark arts.  They dared to challenge the gods, plunder the planes, and travel through rifts of time.  They tampered with the very fundament of existence, and eventually paid a terrible [price] for their actions.'
You say, 'What about this place, Chelsith?'
Norx Blackheart says 'Chelsith was in this very valley, aeons ago.  Once the Green [Mist] drove the wretched Shissar [away], my ancestors tore down the palaces they had constructed as slaves and built the great city of Charasis on the ashes, as free beings.'
You say, 'What about their demise; this 'Mist'?'
Norx Blackheart says 'No one knows the true nature of the Green Mist, only that it came from the skies and bore the very visage of death.  Great winds howled curses in languages unknown.  The Mist descended upon the arrogant Shissar, even as they hurled their most powerful magics against it, and it dissolved the flesh from their very bones.  Rivers of blood and gore flowed through the streets as their cowardly rulers sealed themselves within a great barrier to prepare their [escape].'
You say, 'What dove them away? How did they escape?'
Norx Blackheart says 'The Shissar leaders, desperate to escape the Green [Mist] that assaulted them, used terrible blood magic to transport themselves away.  Most of them were able to reach a sanctuary on the moon of Luclin, but there were rumors that a rebellious group attempted to transport to a hidden laboratory elsewhere on Norrath as well.'
You say, 'Now, about this armor...'
Norx Blackheart says 'In my studies I have come across a method of forging highly intricate armor from the corrupted essence of my [enemy], the Shissar.  If you are able to return a Corrupted Shissar Fang to me, I can use these armor [templates] that I carry to create whatever [ornaments] you like.'
You say, 'What templates?'
Norx Blackheart says 'I have some raw materials to create [plate], [chain], [leather], or [cloth] [ornaments] here.  I simply ask a fair price to cover my costs to create them and fund my studies.'
You say, 'What ornaments?'
Norx Blackheart says 'Simply tell me the type of armor you want -- [Cloth], [Skin], [Chain], or [Plate] -- and I will let you choose an ornament of that type if you provide a Corrupted Shissar [Fang] and the proper [template].'
You say, 'A fang?'
Norx Blackheart says 'All Shissar are evil, of course, but there are some so twisted that they become exceptionally corrupted.  Their corrupted venom collects in their fangs, and I am able to use that power to forge some very special armor.  I make a modest amount of profit in order to continue my research, you get an exquisite ornament to wear, and more Shissar die.  Everyone wins.'
You say, 'How about this chain?'
Norx Blackheart says 'These are the forms of chain armor that I know how to make.'
You have been assigned the task 'Ssraeshzian Chain Armor'.
Norx can create ornaments of Ssraeshzian cloth armor using a Corrupted Shissar Fang and the appropriate template. Give these items to him to choose your reward.
Deliver 1 Ssraeshzian Chain Template to Norx Blackheart 0/1 (The Overthere)
Deliver 1 Corrupted Shissar Fang to Norx Blackheart 0/1 (The Overthere)
Reportedly, Corrupted Shissar Fangs have a low chance to drop off (any?) Shissar in game, but a higher chance (1 in 3?) to drop off raid or named Shissar.
The templates are purchased from Norx Blackheart for ~1,185pp each.
Reward:
- Any one of the seven pieces of armor in the Ssraeshzian Chain Armor Ornament set.
Prior to the July 16, 2013 patch, you were able to get a different set of ornaments based on equipment slot, but these are no longer attainable and now have the "Ancient" label.Rewards:

Tvan Gurrish may be found along the short path behind the chapel in the graveyard area at -750, -1540, +3.75.  He tends to get attacked and killed by "a glyph covered corpse."
You say, 'Hail Tvan Gurrish'
Tvan Gurrish says 'Bah, this is insane. We can't go through with this. Maybe you'd like to pick up some coin, eh? Are you interested?
You say, 'I am interested.'
Tvan Gurrish says 'We were supposed to go up to the graveyard and do a bit of digging, if you know what I mean. There's a fellow that we met up with in a tavern in Shadowhaven that hired us to do this.'
You say, 'What fellow?'
Tvan Gurrish says 'He was odd looking, but he seemed normal enough and he paid us half up front. He said that we'd get the rest when we brought the item back to him.'
You say, 'What item?'
Tvan Gurrish says 'We're not sure. He said we'd know when we saw it. He said to find a grave with black flowers on it and dig it up. Also, we said that we'd need to say a few words before digging. Just in case it was trapped. Here's the scary part. He wrote the words down for us.'
You say, 'What words?'
Tvan Gurrish says 'It looks like a bunch of gibberish to me. If you want them. I'll give them to you. The second that you take the scroll, this is your deal. We don't want no part of this mess. Do you want the Scroll?'
You say, 'I want the scroll.'
You receive an Ale Stained Note and Tvan despawns.  The note reads:
Speak these words
once you
get to the grave
Dal Mar Resh

A tortured abomination will spawn and start attacking you.

# Bridge Escort

**Level:** 1 | **Maximum Level:** 125 | **Quest Type:** Quest | **Repeatable:** Yes | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 1
**Maximum Level:** 125
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** Yes
**Can Be Shrouded?:** No
**Quest Type:** Quest
**Group Size:** Solo

Apparently Deklean wants proof that you can handle the terrors and also wants some liquid courage to take you to the bridge.
Give Deklean Korgad the Fungus-covered hunk of rock, 2 Thought Horror Tentacles and a Deep Cavern Bourbon which can be purchased in Shadowhaven, Echo Caverns and the Bazaar and a few other places.
Deklean Korgad says 'Well I'm impressed Jibbre, you actually went up against some terrors and won. I'll keep my part of the bargain and show you across the chasm. I'm warning you though, this side of the cave is a candy shop compared to the far side.Anyhow, follow me and we'll make our way there.I'm sure you'll be able to dispatch anything we run into on the way, seeing as how you're an accomplished horror slayer!'
Your faction standing with Deklean Korgad has been adjusted by 1.
He then takes the most direct route to the chasm. Left alone he'll die fighting stuff. I also believe he may be susceptible to friendly fire so be careful. Not sure though.
When you get to the chasm and see the fake bridge.
Deklean Korgad says "Well here's the chasm I told you about. Seeing as how you're not very quick, I'd expect you to go barreling across that bridge over there at full speed! That'd get you killed in a hurry. I'm sure the mushrooms would enjoy feeding off of your remains though. Hurry up there now! We haven't got all day!'
When you get to the invisible bridge.
Deklean Korgad says 'Here's where you'll have to trust me friend. Just stay close to me and you'll be fine. And be QUIET! The beasties on the other side aren't nearly as pleasant as the ones over here.'
He leads the way across the bridge walking. Every ten feet or so a beacon appears and lands on the bridge. They look the same as traps. I didn't try to disarm them or remove them. He leads you all the way to the other side.
Deklean Korgad says 'Well here you are, the other side of the chasm. This is where I leave you, I need to take care of some things over here. I'm sure you'll be just fine as long as you stay quiet. Good luck to you friend.'
Hail him again to show him how quiet you are.
You say, 'Hail, Deklean Korgad'
Deklean Korgad puts his hand over your mouth. 'Shuuuush! You may not be afraid of any of these beasties, but there's no reason to make all this noise and make them come running! (Diacritical mark missing here in text after the exclamation mark)
He remains up for a few minutes and the beacons disappear a few minutes after he vanishes.
Nothing fancy. No new toys. Not sure if there is a way to trigger the beacons. Submitted by: SeverrianRewards:
[

# The Grimling War

**Level:** 55 | **Maximum Level:** 125 | **Quest Type:** Quest | **Repeatable:** Yes | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 55
**Maximum Level:** 125
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** Yes
**Can Be Shrouded?:** No
**Quest Type:** Quest
**Group Size:** Group

> The Grimling War is an event that takes place throughout the entire Grimling Forest. There are a number of drops that are obtained from multiple named throughout the event and it is required to be completed in order to do a number of quests whose Quest givers will not spawn until its completion.
> In order to progress through the war the player(s) involved will follow various Vah Shir NPCs located in the Vah Shir fort in the southeast of the zone to specific Grimling camps scattered throughout the zone. Some of the camps are locked behind successfully overtaking the previous camps and it is STRONGLY advised to only attack a single camp at a time as sending multiple Vah Shir NPCs out simultaneously can cause scripts to not trigger correctly.
> War progress can be viewed at any time by speaking to General Staginar located in one of the small buildings inside the Vah Shir fort.
> The event must be fully completed within 24 hours or everything resets.
> After completing the event it takes 12 days +- a few hours for it to reset.
You say, 'Hail, General Staginar'
General Staginar says 'Greetings, Ducreux. I'm troubled that we have not yet been able to fully clear out the remaining Grimlings from the camps they still hold, I know [which camps] we have to assault to proceed, and it'll be just a matter of time before we can move forth with our plans.'
You say, 'which camps'
General Staginar says 'My scouts report the following to me...'
We have not yet cleared camp one to the North!
We have not yet cleared camp two, to the North, of enemy forces.
We have not yet cleared camp three, to the West, of enemy forces.
We have not yet cleared camp four, to the West, of enemy forces.
We have not yet cleared camp five, to the West, of enemy forces.
We have not yet cleared camp six, to the West, of enemy forces.
We have not yet cleared camp seven, to the Northwest, of enemy forces.
We have not yet cleared camp eight, along the river to the North!
We have not yet cleared camp nine, to the North, of enemy forces.
> To begin the War (assuming no camps are currently cleared) speak to one of the three Scouts located inside the Vah Shir fort. NOTE: It does not matter which Scout you send out, they will all select a camp at random and you only need to speak to one of them.
You say, 'Hail, Scout Husman'
Scout Husman says 'Greetings, Bobbybick. Are you [here to help]? You've no doubt heard of the issues with the Grimlings throughout the forest. I fear we may not be able to push them back enough this time to keep our people safe from the dastardly deeds of those vile things. Reports have come in that they may be trying to come at us from the North. While it wouldn't be unheard of, such a move might prove to be a decoy for other attacks coming from the West.'
You say, 'here to help'
Scout Danarin says 'I'm glad to hear it. From our reports, they have a rather small group of soldiers North of here, comprising of two encampments not far from each other. We must begin pushing the Grimlings back to their mines so they cannot continue to have a stronghold in this area. For now, you must gather together a group of soldiers to venture with you to help us clear one of the camps out. When you are [ready to go], inform me of such and I will lead you to the camp where you can make preparations for battle.'
You say, 'ready to go'
Scout Danarin says 'Right, then. We'll be making our way to, what we believe, is their number one camp, leading the way for the other camp northward down to us. Make sure you have everyone with you, we'll be making our way to the camp in just a minute.'
- Follow the scout to Camp 1.
Scout Danarin says 'Here we are, at their primary camp to the direct North of our outpost. It is up to you to clear the camp of these worrisome Grimlings so we can help to push them back into those wretched mines. They'll likely use the hills behind those huts as cover for their casters, but be sure to clear out those in the huts first, as they will no doubt be more trouble than you are expecting. Also, watch out for any officers, as they can cause more problems still if you're not careful. When you are [ready to start], let me know and I will let you loose to wreak havoc on the Grimlings of that camp.'
Your primary objective is to eliminate the main force of the camp and then assault the casters on the hills afterward. Good luck!
You say, 'I am ready to start'
Scout Danarin says 'Now is the time, my friends, to prove yourselves in the thick of battle! Charge to the enemy and leave no Grimling standing!'
- Clear the camp of Grimlings, some will be untargettable until the others are killed. After you have fully cleared all the generic grimlings Arcanist Ukigit will become targetable. Defeat him in order to successfully take Camp 1.
- Speak to a Scout again to begin the assault on Camp 2.
You say, 'ready to go'
Scout Derrin says 'Right, then. We'll be making our way to their secondary camp, which we believe follows the first into battle and may be the back up lines for the first camp. Make sure you have everyone with you, we'll be making our way to the camp in just a minute.'
- Follow the scout to Camp 2
Scout Derrin says 'We have arrived at the second camp to the direct North of our outpost. It is up to you to clear the camp of these bothersome Grimlings so we can help to push them back into those desolate mines. Our reports suggest that they have powerful shaman who may try to stop you with spirits of the land. Do not let them consume you with their shamanistic ways, and instead focus on the rest of the Grimlings in the camp. When you are [ready to begin], let me know and I will let you loose to rid this camp of it's foul denizens.'
You say, 'ready to begin'
Scout Husman says 'To arms, now! Rush into the heart of the beast and emerge victorious, as we have discussed! Charge!'
- Clear the camp of grimlings. NOTE : There currently is a bug where one of the "a grimling gruntling" for this camp spawns in the far west of the zone then has some glitchy pathing causing him to often get stuck inside the tunnels leading to Acrylia caverns. Common areas he is found have been marked on the map but it is recommended to bring a tracker that can sort by latest spawntime. Once all the grimlings in the camp and the bugged gruntling are dead the 4 Spiritchanters by the fire should become targettable. Killing these 4 will spawn Soul Echo, another named Grimling, whose defeat will cause Camp 2 to be successfully taken.
- At this point you can now speak to either Captain Necin or ANY of the 3 Veterans located in the Vah Shir base camp in order to proceed in attacking Camps 3-9.
Speaking to the Veterans will lead you to attacking (randomly) camps 3, 4, 5, and 6. Captain will lead to camps 7, 8, and 9.
You say, 'Hail, Veteran Cullin'
Veteran Cullin says 'Greetings to you, Bobbybick. Are you [here to help] further our cause and continue to push back the Grimling forces? You look to be no stranger to the battles that go on and seem to be competent enough to aid us in this, our daily fight.'
You say, 'here to help'
Veteran Cullin says 'I'm glad to hear that. As you may or may not know, the Grimlings have a series of camps to the West, where they can easily push forward to take us out. We must strike them before they have a chance to do this. You will need to gather two groups of capable soldiers together for this mission, as it will be quite dangerous. When you are [ready to go], let me know and I will lead the way to one of the camps.'
You say, 'ready to go'
Veteran Cullin says 'Very well, then. We'll be making our way to the camp closest to the base, directly West of us. We believe that to be the spearhead of the area, and will lead the rest of the camps nearby were an attack to occur. Make sure you have everyone you need with you, we'll be heading out in just a minute.'
- Follow the Veteran to camp 3
Veteran Cullin says 'This is it, the third camp in the forest, directly West of our outpost. We leave it in your hands to dispatch these vile Grimlings so we can help to push them back into those austere mines. I have had Scout Felles meet us here to give us the latest intelligence on the camp before we begin.'
Veteran Cullin says 'Scout Felles, what do you have to report?'
Your primary objective is to eliminate the main force of the camp yet maintain control of the reinforcements. Good luck!
Scout Felles says 'Sir, it looks as though the layout of this camp provides for a small number of initial Grimlings, however they will be reinforced quickly once a battle begins from outside the camp. I advise keeping calm and maintaining focus or else you will be lost in this fight. When you are [ready to start], inform the Veteran of such so he can direct you to the fight and clear the spearhead that this camp is for the Grimlings.'
You say, 'ready to start'
Veteran Cullin lets out a howling war cry and shouts 'Rid the forest of those dastardly Grimlings, attack!'
- Clear the grimling camp. Once the initial spawn is cleared 7-8 more grimlings will rush into the camp which also need to be killed. After all generic grimlings are down named grimling Officer Tregli will spawn. Defeating him will cause Camp 3 to be Successfully Taken.
- Speak to another Veteran to begin the next assault.
You say, 'ready to go'
Veteran Darznel says 'Very well, then. We'll be making our way to the fourth camp in the forest, directly behind the spearhead of camp three. This is the main force that could cause considerable trouble were they to attack, so it is imperative we clear out whatever forces are there. Make sure you have everyone you need with you, we'll be heading out in just a minute.'
- Follow the Veteran to Camp 4
Veteran Darznel says 'Stay close, we are among the other camps and there's no way to know for sure if other of those dastardly Grimlings are nearby. We are depending on you to make this fight short and without cause, and to help push back these wicked beasts from whence they came. I have had Scout Nivren meet us here to give us the latest intelligence on the camp before we begin.'
Veteran Darznel says 'Scout Nevrin, what do you have to report?'
Your primary objective is to rid the camp of its soldiers, and be wary of the clerics until that is accomplished. Good luck!
Scout Nivren says 'Sir, we have heard that they keep their best clerics in this camp to help heal and revive the front lines during an attack. We have also heard that they gain their strength from the number of Grimling soldiers near to them, so keep that in mind. When you are [ready to begin], let the Veteran know so he can direct you to the fight to slay the clerics that are keeping the forces of evil healed and ready to fight.'
You say, 'ready to begin'
Veteran Darznel says 'Cry havoc and let slip the dogs of war! Let no Grimling escape their fate!'
- Clear the camp of grimlings. NOTE: The grimlings here will instantly respawn as you kill them until the right ones are defeated or pulled away from the others. Defeating all the grimlings will successfully take Camp 4.
- Speak to another Veteran to begin the next assault.
You say, 'ready to go'
Veteran Darznel says 'Very well, then. We'll be making our way to the fifth camp in the forest, at the tail end of the camps in that area. It is our belief that this camp holds the reinforcement wave of their attack force, so it is important to rid ourselves of the threat. Make sure you have everyone you need with you, we'll be heading out in just a minute.'
- Follow the Veteran to camp 5.
Veteran Darznel says 'Do not stray, we are in the thick of the enemy and might be surprised at any moment. You are the hope we have for securing this camp for the cause and helping to push back those contemptible Grimlings to the mines. I have had Scout Harsbren meet us here to give us the latest intelligence on the camp before we begin.'
Veteran Darznel says 'Scout Harsbren, what do you have to report?'
Your primary objective is to clear out the main force of the camp and eliminate the more powerful casters nearby. Good luck!
Scout Harsbren says 'Sir, this is their long-range support camp, with some of their more powerful casters in tow. From the looks of it, they are planning some kind of specialized magic attack that will likely injure some in your party. Do not let it stop you though, for only great resilience will help you win this fight. When you are [ready to fight], let the Veteran know so he can direct you to the fight and clear out this menace before it has a chance to come to fruition.'
You say, 'ready to fight'
Veteran Darznel says 'Remember your training, and let the blood of beasts drench your swords!'
- Clear the camp of grimlings. There is a group of grimling casters on top of the hill on a wooden platform that will cast weak spells on you, defeat them as well. Clearing the entire camp will successfully take over Camp 5.
- Speak to another Veteran to begin the next assault.
You say, 'ready to go'
Veteran Cullin says 'Very well, then. We'll be making our way to a trailing, sixth camp, North of the other three. It is believed that in an attack, this camp would make up a flanking force and would come around from behind us and leave us no room to retreat. We must make sure that none of the Grimlings are allowed to pursue this line of attack. Make sure you have everyone you need with you, we'll be heading out in just a minute.'
- Follow the Veteran to camp 6.
Veteran Cullin says 'We've made it at last. Do not stray, we do not know where there may be Grimlings ready to jump out and attack. We are depending on you soldiers to help clear out this camp so that we can further our push into the heart of the Grimling forces and overtake the town at last. I have had Scout Korin meet us here to give us the latest intelligence on the camp before we begin.'
Veteran Cullin says 'Scout Korin, what do you have to report?'
Your primary objective is to eliminate the main force of the camp yet maintain control of the reinforcements. Keep an eye out for any officers that join the battle. Good luck!
Scout Korin says 'Sir, this camp seems to be similar to camp three, except that it is more heavily fortified from the mines beyond. This camp is the focal point for a flanking maneuver, so it is crucial that they are eliminated. There are reports that they have an officer among them, so keep your eyes out for him during your battle. When you are [ready to battle], let the Veteran know so he can direct you to the fight and clear out this flanking threat before they have a chance to strike.'
You say, 'ready to battle'
Veteran Cullin says 'The battle begins here and now! Charge in and let them see we will not be opposed!'
- Clear the camp of grimlings. After the first initial spawn some more grimlings should appear with an untargettable Officer Grugaht with them, clear the rest of the generic grimlings to make him attackable. After the Officer is defeated Camp 6 will be successfully taken.
- Speak to Captain Necin to begin the assaults on Camps 7-9
You say, 'Hail, Captain Necin'
Captain Necin says 'Strength to you, Bobbybick. Have you come to [aid us] in our fight against the vile Grimlings of this forest as they try to push forth and destroy us? You certainly look capable enough to do just that and I would hope that you are not just here to gawk while we fight a worthwhile fight for our very heritage.'
You say, 'I have come to aid you' **CANNOT USE BRACKETED TEXT**
Captain Necin says 'Very good. It is good to know there is still honor among soldiers, even in these trying times. For now, we will be concentrating on the three camps nearest to the mines, between the mines and the town to the North. You will need to gather together three able bodied groups to venture forth for this mission. When you are [ready to go], inform me thusly and I will lead the way.'
You say, 'ready to go'
Captain Necin says 'Alright, let's be on our way. Our target for this mission is the camp directly South of the mines. This is their defensive position to enemy encroachment from the South. It is necessary to decimate this camp so we can keep a strong foothold in preventing them from moving South and occupying those four camps. Make sure everyone is with you, we'll be heading out in just a minute.'
- Follow the Captain to Camp 7.
Captain Necin says 'We have arrived at our destination, and just in time to wreak havoc on the unsuspecting Grimling beasts that are about to meet their creator. You must note that they have a tower where they will be firing down upon you things you may not be expecting. Keep focused and watch out for any other officers that may decide to reinforce the camp mid-fight. When you are [ready to start], let me know and I will let you loose to absolve the Grimlings of their hold on this camp.'
Your primary objective is to eliminate the waves in the camp, then eliminate the tower guards when you can. Beware any officers that join the battle. Good luck!
You say, 'ready to start'
Captain Necin says 'Take no prisoners! Attack!'
- Defeat the grimlings at the camp. There are two spawns of 10ish grimlings each with a named grimling, Bloodguard Kavgis which will become targettable after all generic grimlings are defeated. Clearing all the grimlings and the named will successfully take over Camp 7.
- Speak to Captain Necin to begin the next assault
You say, 'ready to go'
Captain Necin says 'Alright, let's be on our way. Our target for this mission is the first camp we come to as we follow the river North. This is one of two pivotal points before we can cut the Grimlings in the mines off from those in the town. Make sure you have everyone with you, we'll be heading out in just a minute.'
- Follow the Captain to Camp 8.
Captain Necin says 'Stay low, we don't want to reveal ourselves before we're ready. We're counting on you to be vigilant during this fight and remove the threat to the outpost as quickly as you can. Our reports suggest that they may try to ambush you from the direction of the mines, but we haven't been able to get definite intelligence on that aspect. Stay sharp though, you'll need it for this fight, and make sure to keep your eyes open for any officers that may join the fray. When you are [ready to begin], let me know and I will let you loose into the camp to bring another under our control in the name of ridding this menace from the forest.'
Your primary objective is to clear out the camp, but be wary of any ambush from beyond the camp. Be wary of any officers that join the battle. Good luck!
You say, 'ready to begin'
Captain Necin says 'Shed their blood until no Grimlings are left standing! Charge!'
- Clear the camp of grimlings. Two spawns of 10ish generic grimlings followed by a fight with another named grimling, Warblood Sindrig. After the grimlings and named are dead Camp 8 will be successfully taken.
- Speak to Captain Necin to begin the next assault
You say, 'ready to go'
Captain Necin says 'Alright, let's be on our way. Our target for this mission is the second camp we come to as we follow the river North. This is one of two pivotal points before we can cut the Grimlings in the mines off from those in the town. Make sure you have everyone with you, we'll be heading out in just a minute.'
Captain Necin says 'This is it, the ninth camp and farthest camp to the North of the forest. Before you begin, you should understand that we are relying on you to rid this camp of its nefarious hosts so that we can move forth to the town. There is a defector among their ranks named Gelg who has information on the town that we must retrieve. Your primary focus is keeping Gelg alive at all costs. If he dies, the mission is a failure and we will have to try some time later. Watch out for any commanders that may join the fight, as they're sure to be looking to slay Gelg for his treachery. When you are [ready to fight], let me know and I will let you loose to save this traitor from the enemy's clutches.'
Your primary objective is to keep the traitor Gelg alive at all costs. Be aware of any officers that come looking to slay Gelg, and eliminate them before they have the chance. Good luck!
You say, 'ready to fight'
Captain Necin says 'For victory! Charge!'
NOTE: This is a VERY easy camp to fail. There is a named grimling "Gelg the Traitor" which spawns immediately at the beginning of the assault and MUST be kept alive until the camp is successfully taken. He will be attacked by any standard grimling and can be accidentally killed by the player. Carefully clear the camp while ensuring nothing is beating on Gelg the Traiter. After the first wave of grimlings is dead a second will spawn along with named grimling, Nightknife Gresga, which must be killed in order to take the camp. After defeating all generic grimlings, Nightknife Gresga, AND keeping Gelg the Traitor alive Camp 9 will be successfully taken.
Gelg the Traitor says 'You have done well, and the felines will no doubt welcome the information I have for them. I must be on my way to their outpost now, thank you again for keeping me safe from harm.'
- At this point camps 1-9 should all be successfully taken. If not General Staginar will tell you which camps have been taken and which are still remaining.
- Speak to General Staginar back at the Vah Shir base camp inside one of the buildings. This will lead to the assault on the 10th, and final Grimling camp. NOTE: Even at higher levels you will likely need 1-3 other players in order to deal with the success mechanics this camp requires.
You say, 'Hail, General Staginar'
General Staginar says 'Salutations, Bobbybick. No doubt you've seen the carnage we've dealt to those filthy Grimlings and have decided to stick around and [help us battle] the remaining forces in the town they hold to the North. If this is so, we readily welcome you to join the battle and push back those beasts back to the depths of the mine from whence they came!
You say, 'help us battle'
General Staginar says 'I'm glad you have decided to join us in the battle! Our target will be the town to the far Northeast corner, where the horde of Grimlings has been separated from their cohorts in the mines. You'll need to get several groups of your finest soldiers together before we can head there to try to push the Grimlings out. When you are [ready to go], let me know and I'll make preparations to lead you there.'
You say, 'ready to go'
General Staginar says 'Very well, then, let us be on our way. Our target for this mission is the town in the Northeastern-most part of the forest. This is their final stronghold and if we can successfully decimate the populous of the town, we can finally claim full control of the forest. Make sure you have everyone with you, we'll be heading out in just a minute.'
- Follow General Staginar north of the Vah Shir fort to Camp 10.
General Staginar says 'This is it, the entrance to the town. This is the final fight, so be ready for anything. Within, there are six huts, and each needs to be taken control of and held before we can claim the main part of the town and battle whatever nefarious evil lay in wait beyond. A group of soldiers each keep hold of a single hut and clear out any opposition that makes its way toward you. If all goes well, we'll have this town under our control in no time at all. When you are [ready to start], let me know and we shall begin this bloodthirsty battle for the final push to victory!'
Your primary objective is to take and hold each of the six huts in the town. Beyond that, you must be vigilant in your fight. Good luck!
You say, 'ready to start'
General Staginar says 'Remember the strategy! Keep them off their guard at every turn! Attack!'
> This is the final part of the Grimling War. There are 6 buildings throughout this camp that must ALL be cleared simultaneously in order to progress. This camp has a very unique mechanic in that the grimlings inside each building will VERY quickly respawn if they are killed or if they are pulled out of their buildings, EXCEPT if there is a player/mercenary/pet standing within a small radius of their spawn location. The straightforward method is to simply clear each building then have a player stand inside it, guard a pet, or park a mercenary inside (set yourself to puller) in order to prevent the respawn, repeat this for all 6 buildings or until you are able to kill the remaining grimlings before respawns occur.
> After the first "wave" of super respawning enemies has been overcome, groups of 4-5 grimlings will begin to spawn throughout the camp which must all be defeated, no special mechanics observed for this. Once these are all defeated, a group of grimlings and skeletons will spawn in a small alcove of rocks inside the camp, along with an untargetable Claw of Khati Sha named NPC. Defeat the grimlings and skeletons and the Claw of Khati Sha will become active and charge you.
> Defeating the Claw of Khati Sha will successfully complete the Grimling War. This will cause Camp 10 to respawn as friendly Vah Shir NPCs along with 4 Quest NPCs: Agent Tiesh, Prospector Keykis, Lieutenant Venris, and Major Ehmdish. NOTE: Camp respawn can take 5-10 minutes, do not be alarmed if they don't immediately appear.
You say, 'Hail, General Staginar'
General Staginar says 'Hello, Bobbybick. You're a bit too late to help with the final fight in the town to the North. We've already sent a group of soldiers to eradicate those little Grimling pests and expect to emerge victorious in short order.
Veteran Cullin says 'We appreciate your enthusiasm in pushing back the Grimlings, but at this time we have managed to push them back to the mines, where we hope to keep them. You may want to venture up to the town to the North and see if any of our soldiers have need for you there.'
Scout Husman says 'We have successfully pushed back the Grimling horde to the mines. At this point, there is no need for your help, but be on the lookout, for they may always get the better of us and reclaim what we now hold. You may wish to look to the Town, which has others of us stationed there to see if they might have need for you.'
Unknown how long the camps will stay in control of the Vah Shir before the event resets. Observed them staying under their control for at least 4 hours before I left the zone. Submitted by: BobbybickRewards:
- Copper Medal of War [item=25047]
[

# Access to Empires of Kunark (The Nexus Portal)

**Level:** 1 | **Maximum Level:** 130 | **Quest Type:** Quest | **Repeatable:** No | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 1
**Maximum Level:** 130
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** No
**Can Be Shrouded?:** No
**Quest Type:** Quest
**Group Size:** Solo

Information on how to access The Nexus Portal to Empires of Kunark.
Speak to any of the 4 NPC's in the center of The Nexus.
Fani Dertrimas
Jayson Bri`Tian
Kardador Tarsinian
Persy Clutches
Jayson Bri`Tian says 'Ahh, welcome {name]. It is good to see more and more people visiting now that the portals are functional. It took us many, many years to understand the magical powers of Luclin. Whether through dumb luck or divine intervention, we have succeeded in opening the gate back to Norrath. How long it will stay open, no one knows. I hope you know the importance of the stone that lies beneath our feet and the power that the Combine have been able to harvest from it? Even if you do not, we are willing to allow you to use that  'power'. My colleagues and I are here to maintain and watch for changes in the Nexus- should anything happen, you will be notified. Safe travels.'
You say, 'power'
He hands you a Spire Stone of Lceanium [item=126769]. Stand in the center near the NPC's that give you the stone. Soon you will be ported.
Jayson Bri`Tian says 'We, of course, have tapped into the power of transportation, as I'm sure you realize. With the restoration of our great Emperor... I mean Lord Katta, we have been asked to help those that wish to visit his new seat of power. If you wish to go there, this very spire will take you. All you need is a Spire Stone of Lceanium and you will be safely transported to the city. We have set up this great spire to transport anyone holding such a stone every few minutes, as the cycle of power peaks. It is no minor magical feat to send a large group of creatures safely from Luclin to Kunark! But feel assured that we can do so, and we almost never lose any transportees.'
Jayson Bri`Tian says 'Here is your Spire Stone. Remember, if you are holding that stone and remain in the area of the spire, you will be transported. The stone is fragile and will be consumed if you travel by the spire or just about any other means. Not to worry, we can provide you another if needed.'
-
A Mystic Voice says, 'The portal to Lceanium will become active in 20 seconds. Please gather in the portal area and make sure you have your Spire Stone of Lceanium on your person.
A Mystic Voice says, 'The portal to Lceanium will become active in 10 seconds. Please gather in the portal area and make sure you have your Spire Stone of Lceanium on your person.
A Mystic Voice says, 'The portal to Lceanium is now active. Please stand on the pad and you will be teleported shortly. Enjoy your time in the city.'Rewards:
[

# Corrupted Hammer of Consternation

**Level:** 1 | **Maximum Level:** 125 | **Quest Type:** Quest | **Repeatable:** No | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 1
**Maximum Level:** 125
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** No
**Can Be Shrouded?:** No
**Quest Type:** Quest
**Group Size:** Solo

This quest was added around August 2015 so it may not be available on progression servers.
1. Kill Praetorian Myral
Praetorian Myral [npc=7586] is located towards the Scarlet Desert zone line in the southern most room at /loc -450, +1400.
Loot the Divine Hammer of Consternation [item=12657] and the Scythe of Sundering [item=11385]. You will need both.
1b (Optional) Find Crumpled Torn Pages, Illegible Torn Pages and Damaged Torn Pages.
These pages drop off various NPCs in Mons Letalis Combine these 3 pages in a Tattered Expedition Log [item=132722] to get a Reconstructed Expedition Log [item=125805] that gives you clues as to why you must rend flesh using the Scythe of Sundering and turn them in.
2. Spawn a shade in Mons Letalis
In order to do this, you (or someone else) will need a Scythe of Sundering [item=11385] to summon 4 Chunk of Flesh [item=29992]. Turn these 4 Chunks of Flesh into a pile of fleshless bones [npc=51799] in Mons Letalis. This will spawn a shade named Praetorian K`Tikrn [npc=54555].
3. Turn in your Divine Hammer of Consternation to the shade
Once the shade spawns, turn in your Divine Hammer of Consternation and you will receive the Corrupted Hammer of Consternation [item=123584].
Submitted by: GidonoRewards:
- Corrupted Hammer of Consternation [item=123584]

# Investigating Deep Within The Caverns

**Level:** 55 | **Maximum Level:** 125 | **Quest Type:** Quest | **Repeatable:** Yes | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 55
**Maximum Level:** 125
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** Yes
**Can Be Shrouded?:** No
**Quest Type:** Quest
**Group Size:** Solo

Prerequisite: You must have just finished the Grimling War [quest=8240] event to get this task.
This quest starts with Lieutenant Venris. He is located in Grimling Forest at +1100, -754, +147 in the Grimling Village after the Grimling War event has been completed.
You say, 'Hail, Lieutenant Venris'
Lieutenant Venris says, 'Ah, _______, we've heard tell of you. The forces of Shar Vahl have need of your skills. But can you live up to your [reputation]?'
You say, 'reputation'
Lieutenant Venris says, 'Very good. I have other less experienced adventurers scouring the upper mine for information. But I need to know what goes on in the deep mine. It's a dangerous mission, but I'm sure you're up to the challenge. Find any orders that guards may carry from within Acrylia Caverns. Put them in this satchel and return them to me. I'll need at least two different examples. Good luck.'
Given Warded Courier's Satchel on your cursor. (2-slot combinable container)
- 1. You must loot Elite Guard's Orders and Death Guard's Orders 0/1 Grimling Forest
These drop off "a grimling elite guard" and "a grimling deathguard".
Combine both orders to in the Warded Courier's Satchel to receive Filled Warded Satchel.
- 2. Return to Filled Warded Satchel to Lieutenant Venris 0/1 Grimling Forest
Upon returning the filled satchel to Venris:
You receive 150 platinum .
Lieutenant Venris says, 'Hmm... These orders only confuse things. They say that any of the 'lesser kin' should be slain on sight. Apparently none of the Grimlings from the forest are even allowed into the caverns without some right of passage. Odd. This changes our picture of the horde. Ah well.'
Your faction standing with Vah Shir Crusaders has been adjusted by 10.
You gain experience! ( 10.475% AA (@lvl 93) )Submitted by: GidonoRewards:
- Elite Guard's Orders [item=23086]
[

# 23rd Anniversary: Death Finds a Way

**Level:** 1 | **Maximum Level:** 130 | **Quest Type:** Task | **Repeatable:** Yes | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 1
**Maximum Level:** 130
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** Yes
**Can Be Shrouded?:** No
**Quest Type:** Task
**Group Size:** Solo

This 23rd anniversary task starts with Krastoraab Puremane in Shar Vahl. He can be found at /waypoint -496, 79, -190 at the entrance of Shar Vahl coming in from Shadeweaver's Thicket. He can also be found via the find tool CTRL F.
You say, 'Hail, Krastoraab Puremane'
Krastoraab Puremane  smiles warmly in your direction before he begins to speak, 'Ah, another who is on the path of enlightenment as am I. My name is Krastoraab and I am a devout follower of the cycle. You may be asking yourself, 'Which [cycle] does he mean?' I will be happy to answer any questions you must have.'
You say, 'cycle'
Krastoraab Puremane says, 'The cycle is an ever stable force between life and death that must be maintained in order to retain the balance of life and death. Should one of these faculties fault, then our entire existence as we know it would cease to be. This cycle, the cycle of loss and rebirth, is perpetuated by the work of [Ehayae and Drinal].'
You say, 'Ehayae and Drinal'
Krastoraab Puremane says, 'I'm glad you asked about them. Many misinterpret the actions of the Matron of the Dawn and the Silver Reaper as respectively good and evil. However, these scholars could be no further from the truth about the deeds that Ehayae and Drinal perform. Their work is often misrepresented due to the nature of their respective offices. Drinal, known for his representation of death, destruction, and night, is often confused with being considered an evil god that is bent on the destruction of life. This is not something Drinal wishes to do out of anger or malice toward the living. This is his duty. Easy it is of the sower to take the credit for the crop, but the crop will not be able to grow without the [Reaper].'
You say, 'Reaper'
Krastoraab Puremane's face glows brighter before continuing, 'I'm more than happy to continue discussing the Silver Reaper with you! Most people look upon him and think that he takes pleasure in culling the life from Norrath. However, without him, the flow of life will grow stagnant and the natural order is thrown off. He doesn't perform his tasks out of glee or happiness over the misery he causes. He performs his duties because he has to. Without his precious work, we would never grow. We would never change. We would never live our fullest lives in the first place. He teaches us with his merciful work that nothing is permanent, and that you can never really lose someone until you let them go, and that loss is a part of a bigger cycle. Dry your tears and rejoice in the cycle! Do this and you too will be renewed by the [Matron of the Dawn] with a new sunrise!'
You say, 'Matron of the Dawn'
Krastoraab Puremane says, 'The 'Matron of the Dawn' is the other name for Ehayae. Her position is often misinterpreted as that of a benevolent being. However, her work is to sow life back into Norrath, and this task is not done out of the goodness of her heart. Once you reap your crop, you are left with a field that needs tending to before it can grow life again. While Drinal ferries the newly reaped souls to their next form, Ehayae is busy sowing life back onto Norrath.  She sows the life, then lets nature take over and whatever happens to that soul through its growth is up to their will to thrive. Whether they take root and climb higher than the other stalks, or they fail to thrive and rot, this is not the work of Ehayae. This would be akin to blaming a farmer when a chef fails to prepare a meal to your liking. The misguided pray in a foolish attempt to Ehayae for special treatment of their children. I have a [lesson] for you, if you wish to know more about the forces of the cycle.'
You say, 'lesson'
You have been assigned the task 'Death Finds a Way'.
Krastoraab Puremane's face is positively beaming with excitement as you show even the slightest interest in the subject at hand. 'Wonderful! As I have mentioned before, some try to give extra gifts to Ehayae when they are expecting a child. This is considered an act of great offense to Ehayae as she sees these types of offerings as a bribe. The point of the dauntless, unrelenting cycle is that none of us are better than each other at the moment of our creation. We are all born of the same equal potential. There is someone who is staying in Shar Vahl who has set up an offering to Ehayae while they are here. Who this is, is not important. Find their offering and bring it to me. This may sound like a cruel prank to do to an expecting parent, but the sage they used for this offering is toxic, especially to newborns. This parent's intentions are pure but they need to be enlightened to the offerings they give. The only reason I am aware of this sage being burned is because it's pungent and I can smell it from here.'
On Norrath, there is a cycle of life and death that must be maintained. THis cycle will happen no matter what forces are at play. Take some time to hear the tales of those who have long passed and learn lessons about the cycle of Drinal and Ehayae.
Krastoraab in Shar Vahl has asked you to collect an incorrectly used offering to Ehayae hidden away somewhere in Shar Vahl.
- 1. Bring the offering to Krastoraab in Shar Vahl 0/1 Shar Vahl
In the far northwest part of the city, there is a 2 story building. You will see 2 Honor Guard's (Honor Guard Siiv and Honor Guard Ishouz) on the 2nd and 3rd floors.
On the south side of the building, go upstairs to the 2nd floor and go in the door. In the far north room, on a chest of drawers is an item that looks like a torch burning at  /waypoint 446, 407, -166, pick it up. It is the Toxic Ehayae's Offering. It has a respawn timer of 6 minutes.
Hand this into Krastoraab.
Your task 'Death Finds a Way' has been updated.
Krastoraab Puremane says, 'Thank you for this. I will dispose of this offering and create a new one to replace it with. In the meantime, there are a few spirit elders I want you to speak to about the cycle. These are other disciples of the cycle who have passed but remain to tell their tales to anybody who will listen to them about the cycle. The shroud around Shar Vahl grows thin during these times, and those spirits can be found located around this city. Find them, hear their tales, and come back to me. The first one is named Jonus. You may need to search for him indoors. I do not know the full tale as to why these spirits stay where they are anchored, but they will not stay anchored for long.'
- 2. Speak with Jonus and hear his tale 0/1 Shar Vahl
Jonus is in the northwest section of the zone back near the same building where you found the torch. Jonus is on the find tool CTRL F.
Hail Jonus to get the update.
Jonus Siedel  speaks in a grizzled, rough tone. The spirit's eyes look sunken, as if he had seen a lifetime of regret before meeting his untimely end. 'Hail adventurer!' His voice sounds like he needs to cough but can't. 'You wish to hear my tale, eh? I'm afraid it's nothing special, though I suppose that is why it is so insidious. I was a mortician and spent my life servicing the recently deceased so that they could have a good transition to the next life.  I worked very hard. I was proud of my work. I eschewed a life of a family man so that I could hone my skills until one day I would surpass my mentors. I spent my life serving Drinal, believing that my work would prepare me for the afterlife. My work is known to many, though nobody knows my name anymore.  Learn from me child. I spent my living days preparing the dead for the same journey I knew i too would be on someday, but didn't spend any time preparing myself. Look for Lorelei. She will be the next spirit you wish to speak to about the cycle.'
- 3. Speak with Lorelei and hear her tale 0/1 Shar Vahl
She is located in corner of the city not far from the building where you found the burning sage. She is on the find tool CTRL F.
Hail her to get the update.
Lorelei Carversbane  barks with a booming voice, triumphant and strong! 'Adventurer! Don't let that sad sack, Jonus, keep you from living your life to the fullest! Take it from me! I was a sellsword who spent her life protecting others. My living days were spent beside many an adventurer much like yourself who wished to best the horrors on Norrath for a brighter future. I have seen many adventures, caves, errands, tasks, drinks, jobs, donnybrooks, conflict, strife, and riches!  All will eventually be dust. Somewhere in the annals of the history books, there are countless tales of all of the findings and adventures that I have seen. Yet, due to my role as a sellsword, my name was long forgotten. Glory means nothing when nobody cares about who performed the heroic acts needed! The cycle is set to its own pace. No matter how much you try to speed it up, you will not be able to influence it. Now, don't be too sad about these tales. Speak with Salk and hear their story!'
- 4. Find and hear what Salk has to say 0/1 Shar Vahl
Salk is located not far from the gate leading out to Hollowshade Moor bridge.
Hail Salk for the update.
Salk Hopfit  responds with a soothing, soft tone in their voice when they address you, 'Greetings traveler. You spoke with Jonus and Lorelei about their cautionary tales. You would be wise to follow the messages they are trying to give you about the cycle. While the cycle is finite, it cannot be predicted. From where there may be ruin, comes triumph. From wherever there is life, there is death, and from wherever there is death, life will someday sprout. Ehayae can sow life, but that life still needs to fight to thrive and grow. It isn't as simple as planting a seed in rich soil. What about those who can thrive where even life cannot? What drives them? Return to whoever it was that told you to seek us out. There is nothing more we can teach you today about the cycle of life and death.'
- 5. Return to Krastoraab 0/1 Shar Vahl
Hail him for the update.
You say, 'Hail, Krastoraab Puremane'
You have been given: Offering to Sahteb Mahlni
Your task 'Death Finds a Way' has been updated.
Krastoraab Puremane says, 'I see you return from speaking to my colleagues. Those spirits were former disciples of the cycle, much like myself. While they still perform their duties, even in death, eventually they too will dissipate and become nothingness, ready to be sown by Ehayae, and culled by Drinal. There is a third entity within the cycle that many people forget is a part of life and death. This entity is Sahteb Mahlni, who is a powerful animal spirit. Many forget the drive it takes to thrive. This constant need to better oneself in one's own existence comes from Sahteb Mahlni. True understanding of how the cycle works stems from understanding that your primal instinct to fight comes from somewhere. Speak with Sineb, one who understands this aspect of rebirth more than any others. They can be found here in Shar Vahl, though they don't find much solace from within the city walls. Bring them this offering. They will know why you are there when they see this.'
- 6. Deliver the offering to Sineb in Shar Vahl 0/1 Shar Vahl
Sineb is on the southern ledge of the city outside the gate walls on the southeast side.
Hand in Offering to Sahteb Mahlni to Sineb.
Your task 'Death Finds a Way' has been updated.
Sineb  snorts in the air as you approach. 'You approach me? Then you are not someone who takes the seriousness of the cycle for granted. The cycle churns endlessly. However, it takes a special kind of strength to thrive within the cycle, even without being aware of it. That drive comes from Sahteb Mahlni. They imbue us with the primal urge needed to grow and prosper while alive. All living creatures house this energy. It is required in order to grow. Without it, we would simply not have any drive, there would be no progress, there would be no strength. The wisdom that one can gain by understanding one's animal instincts and how they are used to strive to create a better world for the pack, not just the individual. If one is to know of the cycle, they must know of Sahteb Mahlni. To prove your understanding, I need you to bring me an offering to Drinal. This offering is something that is carried by the Darkpaw clan in the Jaggedpine Forest. Bring me one of these idols.'
- 7. Locate an Offering to Drinal 0/1 Jaggedpine Forest
Sineb has asked you to bring them an Offering to Drinal. These can be found on the Darkpaw clan members found in the Jaggedpine Forest.
Go to Jaggedpine Forest to the gnoll cave in the north part of the zone. Kill gnolls until you loot a Offering to Drinal. I got mine off a Darkpaw curate.
- 8. Deliver the offering to Sineb in Shar Vahl 0/1 Shar Vahl
Upon turnin of: Offering to Drinal
Your task 'Death Finds a Way' has been updated.
Sineb says, 'You return to me. This is most excellent! You also found an offering! Some of the Darkpaw clan believe that having this offering on them at the time they pass will help pay for their passage with Drinal, in hopes of a smoother transition between lives. This goal is ultimately futile. Though Drinal does appreciate the offerings, he does not have any control over when a soul will be sown again. It is the spirit of Sahteb Mahlni that keeps us putting one paw in front of the next. You will keep this in mind with your journeys, adventurer. Return to Krastoraab. He will be more than delighted to hear about your thoughts on the cycle.'
- 9. Return to Krastoraab 0/1 Shar Vahl
You say, 'Hail, Krastoraab Puremane'
Your task 'Death Finds a Way' has been updated.
Drinal, Ehayae, and Sahteb Mahlni are three of the forces that keep the ebb and flow of life continuing on Norrath. Drinal is the Silver Reaper who culls lives in order to ferry souls to their next stages. Ehayae is known as the Matron of the Dawn and is responsible for sowing life across all of Norrath. However, the primal forces that drive the living to thrive come from Sahteb Mahlni, the Feral Spirit.
You receive 225 platinum .
You receive alternate currency.
Krastoraab Puremane says, 'There you have it, my friend. You now can continue your journeys with the knowledge of the cycle of life and death. There are important lessons within each of these tales. The beauty of the wisdom of the cycle is that you have to be comfortable not knowing the unknowable. Many confuse 'not knowing' as a weakness when in reality, it is impossible for one to know all. Many scholars have lived and died while pondering the very same lesson. The lesson here is that there is no lesson. Sometimes we have to say goodbye early and sometimes we say goodbye far too late for it to matter. There may not be a grand scheme that is being unfolded before your eyes, but life and death are all around us and are an inevitable part of our consciousness. Grow strong in your journey.'

# 23rd Anniversary: Beyond Espoir - Group Mission

**Level:** 115 | **Maximum Level:** 130 | **Quest Type:** Expedition | **Repeatable:** Yes | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 115
**Maximum Level:** 130
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** Yes
**Can Be Shrouded?:** No
**Quest Type:** Expedition
**Time Limit:** 06:00:00
**Group Size:** Group
**Min. # of Players:** 3
**Max. # of Players:** 6

Prerequisite Quest(s): Death Finds a Way [quest=10725]
This group mission is part of the 23rd anniversary.
There is a minimum level to request the mission. (maybe 115? Let us know)
You can get this shared task from Krastoraab Puremane in Shar Vahl. He is in the city at the entrance leading from Shadeweaver's Thicket at /waypoint -496, 79, -190 or you can find him via the find tool CTRL F.
You say, 'Hail, Krastoraab Puremane'
Krastoraab Puremane says, 'If you would like a reminder of why the [cycle] is important, I would be more than glad to talk to you about it again. However, if you wish to continue your [education], I can offer some assistance in that request as well.'
You say, 'education'
Krastoraab Puremane says, 'I'm glad to hear that you decided to take up a higher education about the cycle. You may have noticed that each of the disciples you spoke with are, ironically, not continuing onto the next stage of the cycle. Concepts such as what is "living" and "dead" usually can cause confusion when it comes to living and dying, especially when it comes to the undead. Ghosts and spirits have the capacity to take a moment to pause and observe the cycle. These entities are not outside of the influence of the cycle. It is quite the contrary actually. They are still a part of the cycle of life and death, though their [journey]to Ehayae is postponed for the time being.'
You say, 'journey'
Krastoraab Puremane says, 'The disciples you spoke with want to test your mettle and make sure you fully understand their lessons. If you are willing to take up arms, I have already spoken with the four spirits and they will meet you at the Deep. Be warned as once they start fighting, their emotions will take over and there is no stopping them. You must give them your all in order to defeat them. They will not hold back. Are you sure you are [ready]?'
You have been assigned the task 'Beyond Espoir'.
You say, 'ready'
Krastoraab Puremane says, 'Excellent, I will wait here for your return. To prove to me that you have a full understanding, you will be given a bauble after you have finished your lesson. None of the spirits know what is inside the box so you won't be able to cheat. Bring that item to me.'
LOADING, PLEASE WAIT...
You have entered Trial of the Cycle.
1. Defeat the first disciple, Jonus 0/1 The Deep
Jonus is nearby, where you zone in.
He is not aggro until you hail him. You can kill trash around the area first, if you want to. The various horror fiends (trash MOB's, all appear to be around the level of the highest level in the group) seem to see through both Invisible and Invisible to Undead.
When you hail Jonus he morphs into a Hooded Shade and attacks.
The Bonus step here (for the Challenge Achievement) is to kill him while your health is below 50%. This will require careful healing, after Jonus is below 5% to 10% health.
2. Defeat the second disciple, Lorelei 0/1 The Deep
NOTE: All of the targets (Boss's) are on Find.
When you hail Lorelei, she morphs into a Banshee.
Lorelei Carversbane scowls at you, ready to attack -- looks like quite a gamble. (Lvl: 120)
You say, 'Hail, Lorelei Carversbane'
Lorelei Carversbane says, 'HA HA! Come adventurer, show me what you are made of!'
At about 50%-ish Lorelei Carversbane calls for assistance and two adds spawn and attack you, as well as heal Lorelei Carversbane.
A devout trumpeter (Level 120) will heal Lorelei.
A stalwart herald (Level 120)
They do not de-spawn if Lorelei dies first.
Champions from the past, lend me your aid!
Lorelei Carversbane's corpse disperses and an image of the original Lorelei appears for a moment. 'I had such fun today adventurer! I enjoyed our battle for glory! You understand this more than most! Continue your lesson eastward. Till we meet again!'
You have slain Lorelei Carversbane!
Your task 'Beyond Espoir' has been updated.
The Bonus step here (for the Challenge Achievement) is to kill her while her 'healer' add (a devout trumpeter) is still alive.
3. Defeat the third disciple, Salk 0/1 The Deep
When you hail Salk, she morphs into a Tiger.
You say, 'Hail, Salk Hopfit'
Salk Hopfit says, 'Your path requires balance between life and death. Stray but a hair's width away from the edge and you will not succeed!'
The cycle of life and death demands balance. Are you capable of the same?
Salk Hopfit's corpse dissipates, but an image of Salk appears to say, 'Well fought, you understand why there needs to be a balance between life and death now more than ever. Sineb is waiting for you near the bridge to the northeast.'
You have slain Salk Hopfit!
Your task 'Beyond Espoir' has been updated.
4. Defeat the fourth disciple, Sineb 0/1 The Deep
When you hail Sineb, she morphs into an Owlbear.
You say, 'Hail, Sineb'
Sineb says, 'I will show you what primal energies are at play!'
At 60%-70%, he calls for assistance and two adds spawn, attack and also heal him.
A brawny auger (Level 120)
A primal soothesayer (Level 120)
They do not despawn if Sineb dies first.
Primal forces protect bring me vitality! Ehayae sows...
You gain party experience!
You have slain a primal soothesayer!
You gain party experience!
You have slain a brawny auger!
Balance is required to fully understand where you stand in the cycle. Sahteb Mahlni drives...
You gain party experience!
Sineb's corpse falls, and reappears again as the Sineb you know before saying, 'Well struck! You have completed your path on understanding the cycle! Let me know when you are ready to [leave] and I will bring you back to Shar Vahl.'
You have slain Sineb!
Your task 'Beyond Espoir' has been updated.
Sineb respawns in his original form, once killed.
5. Open the lockbox 0/1 The Deep
Open the lockbox.
Your task 'Beyond Espoir' has been updated.
You have been given: Primal Owlbear Beak
--You have looted a Shroud of Unending Cycles from a lockbox .--
You say, 'Hail, Sineb'
Sineb says, 'Well done mortal. You fully grasp how important the balance of life and death is. You understand that without that fire in your belly to drive you forward, there can be no progress. Moving on from loss is something that we all have to deal with from time to time. That does not mean we forget who we lost. We just get better at fighting without them by our side. Remember this, and you will do well in your future struggles. Now, if you wish to [leave], I can show you the exit. Grow in your adventures as you would, but remember that everyone is fighting their own fights. May the cycle watch over you and bless you in your journeys.'
You say, 'leave'
LOADING, PLEASE WAIT...
You have entered Shar Vahl.
6. Return the beak to Krastoraab 0/1 Shar Vahl
Give the Primal Owlbear Beak to Krastoraab Puremane.
Krastoraab Puremane says, 'Excellent. Thank you for returning this to me. This proves that you were able to overcome the challenges that the disciples have given you. Your understanding is complete. Without Ehayae's work, there can be no death. Without Drinal's work, there can be no life. Without Sahteb Mahlni, there can be no strength or drive for progress. Thank you for taking these lessons to heart Bonzz. I do hope we cross paths again in the future. Until then, go in peace and know that you play an important role in cycle of life and death.'
Your task 'Beyond Espoir' has been updated.
You have received a replay timer for 'Beyond Espoir': 0d:0h:2m remaining.
Your education about the work of Ehayae, Drinal, and Sahteb Mahlni is complete.
You receive alternate currency.
You have completed achievement: 23rd Anniversary Mission
OPTIONAL STEP
You can turn in the Primal Owlbear Beak to Sineb in Shar Vahl to receive "Fungal Shrieker Spore," which is a pet clicker that summons a pet with stats or can change the look of your pet.
Upon turn in,
Sineb says, 'I have to admin, when Krastoraab gave us the lockbox as part of the test, we didn't know what was inside. Bringing this to me confirms my fears. Wherever this beak was found, it was a place of immense power. I do not know where he got this, but he would be wise to return it to whatever corner of Luclin it was taken from. Take this. It should protect you in your journeys. Give the beak back to Krastoraab. I will speak with him later about what he has found, once I learn what it means myself.'
Reward(s):
You gain experience!
20 Commemorative Coins [item=116720]
Loot from the chest

# 23rd Anniversary: Whispers in the Dark - Group Mission

**Level:** 115 | **Maximum Level:** 130 | **Quest Type:** Expedition | **Repeatable:** Yes | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 115
**Maximum Level:** 130
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** Yes

**Quest Type:** Expedition
**Group Size:** Group
**Min. # of Players:** 1
**Max. # of Players:** 6

You can get this group mission by talking to Spiritist Nathra about mid zone around the pool at /waypoint -89, -193, -188. They are on the find tool CTRL F.
We need all dialogue, details to each step and task window text for each step.
You say, 'Hail, Spiritist Nathra'
Spiritist Nathra says, 'Hail and well met. It's good that you've reached out to me, for I'm quite [troubled].'
You say, 'Why are you troubled?'
Spiritist Nathra says, 'The spirits are crying out to me. One of their [whisperling] kin has been stolen, and they fear for the safety of the little spirit, especially when he is reported to be in the hands on the [poachers]. Would you be able to [help]?'
You say, 'What is a whisperling?'
Spiritist Nathra says, 'Whisperlings are the spirits who bring our night visions, our dreams. You could say that they "whisper" to us in our sleep. They do not persist in our world by default, but only if they are attached by a spirit anchor, which keeps them in our physical realm. It doesn't hurt the whisperling, but it needs a strong anchor to maintain its hold.'
You say, 'What poachers do you mean?'
Spiritist Nathra says, 'The Loda Kai poachers in and of themselves are not directly concerning, as objects such as the whisperling's spirit anchor may be considered more for-profit than something more dangerous for the little spirit. However, it's also known that the Loda Kai are loosely allied with the [Shak Dratha]. At the very least, they have openly bartered. It's the Shak Dratha that I'm worried about. If the Loda Kai traded it over to them... I don't want to think about it.'
You say, 'What of the Shak Dratha?'
Spiritist Nathra says, 'The Shak Dratha delve into the dark arts of the spirit. Their hearts are full of shadow, whether they weave silk directly from it, or pull from it to consume a traveler's soul. If he changes hands before we can get to him, our whisperling friend may not be long for this or any world.'
You say, 'I would like to help.'
Spiritist Nathra says, 'You have no idea how much we appreciate this. I can [lead] you to the cavern shared with me, but from there, it's up to you and any adventuring companions you wish to have accompany you. I'm ready when you are.'
You have received a request timer for 'Whispers in the Dark': 0d:1h:0m remaining.
You have been assigned the task 'Whispers in the Dark'
You say, 'lead'
LOADING, PLEASE WAIT...
You have entered Shadeweaver's Thicket: Whispers in the Dark.
- 1. Check in with Spiritist Nathra 0/1 Shadeweaver's Thicket
Hail Spiritist Nathra
- 2. Explore the Loda Kai poachers' cavern 0/1 Shadeweaver's Thicket
Update around location -1529, 40, -293
- 3. Defeat several Loda Kai 0/8 Shadeweaver's Thicket
Kill any a Loda Kai
They are all Level 116 to 118.
It is recommended to dispel their damage shields and buffs.
- 4. Check the chest on the far end of the Loda Kai cavern 0/1 Shadeweaver's Thicket
The chest is in the east side where the Loda Kai are at around location -1543, -180, -431
After opening the chest, 'The chest has alerted the Shak Dratha. Defend yourself!
2x 'a Shak Dratha guardsman' appear around the nearby rock
- 5. Defeat the Shak Dratha that have spotted you! 0/2 Shadeweaver's Thicket
Kill 2 'a Shak Dratha guardsman'
They spawn next to two Loda Kai around the rock and they can be pulled single with cc.
- 6. Move north to explore the northern pathway 0/1 Shadeweaver's Thicket
Update around location -303, -171, -429   this is right before you enter the next cavern from the Loda Kai area.
- 7. Continue deeper into the caverns, moving further north 0/1 Shadeweaver's Thicket
'This room is heavily guarded which is a good indication that the whisperling is hidden here.'
Update around location 13, -148, -291
- 8. Defeat several Shak Dratha 0/8 Shadeweaver's Thicket
Kill any a Shak Dratha IN the room. The script is bugged and killing roamers and certain mobs over and over again may jam the mission.
They are all level 116 to 118.
It is recommended to dispel their damage shields and buffs.
- 9. Check the chest on the far end of the Shak Dratha training cavern 0/1 Shadeweaver's Thicket
Update around location 891, -766, -480
Note: before you continue and open the chest to loot the Khrix, it is recommended to clear out the area around the Shak Dratha Overseer spawn location.
- 10. Pick up the whispering Khrix 0/1 Shadeweaver's Thicket
Loot 'Khrix' from 'a secured chest'
- 11. Return south to the circular room and head back to Spiritist Nathra 0/1 Shadeweaver's Thicket
Update around location -258, 248, -430
'The Shak Dratha Overseer is blocking the exit south!'
- 12. Kill the Shak Dratha Overseer 0/1 Shadeweaver's Thicket
This step can be completed at any time and still get credit
Shak Dratha Overseer is a rare creature, level 123
At ~80% and ~45% 'Shak Dratha Overseer yells, 'Guards! Xauis xua!'
'A guard comes at the Overseer's call.'
a Shak Dratha guardsman will appear
An easy way to kill the Overseer without CC is to camp the corridor south of the boss spawn point, wait for roamers and kill them one by one, then pull boss
and kill adds as they spawn.
Loot an Owl Totem

Loot "Khrix" and "Owl Totem" on the same character
Target Spiritist Nathra and say, 'spirit anchor'
Spiritist Nathra says, 'It's possible that with the Shak Dratha's work with spirits and shadows that they have a strong spirit anchor that could bring strength to the whisperling. We don't know the current state of our friend, so please take this bag and if you find a sufficient anchor in the caverns, please use this bag to strengthen the whisperling with the spirit anchor before bringing him back to me.'
You receive Empty Medicine Bag

Mission locks here

'a reward chest' spawns around location -1850, -304, -247

# 23rd Anniversary: Risky Rat Rescue - Group Mission

**Level:** 113 | **Maximum Level:** 130 | **Quest Type:** Expedition | **Repeatable:** Yes | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 113
**Maximum Level:** 130
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** Yes
**Can Be Shrouded?:** No
**Quest Type:** Expedition
**Time Limit:** 06:00:00
**Group Size:** Group
**Min. # of Players:** 1
**Max. # of Players:** 6

You can obtain this group mission by speaking to Drifter Minki in The Nexus near the Odus portal pad. Drifter Minki is on the find tool (Ctrl+F).
You say, 'Hail, Drifter Minki'
Drifter Minki says, 'Ika! Ika! Hail, adventurer! Please wait! Minki could really use your [help]!'
You say, 'What do you need help with?'
Drifter Minki says, 'Aakaka, Minki is so relieved! You are the first person to notice me. Are you familiar with [Velious]?'
You say, 'Velious is a barren, icy wasteland.'
Drifter Minki looks up at you with wide eyes. 'Kwee! Do you not like Velious?' He lets out a squeaky laugh. 'Yiyiyiyi, Minki understands. All of that ice is so blinding! So ugly! But Velious is where Minki is from and where Minki's [brother] is.'
You say, 'Are you looking for your brother?'
Drifter Minki nods emphatically. 'Yes! Minki feels very guilty. Minki made a [daring escape] from the evil Zlandicar and evil Chetari... but Minki left Minki's brother Rinki behind.' His eyes begin to glimmer with tears. 'Minki is eya visso. Very sad.'
You say, 'Tell me more about your daring escape.'
Drifter Minki rubs the tears from his eyes and sniffs back a bubble of snot threatening to drip from his nose. 'Minki is so tired of fighting the Chetari. One day, Minki heard rumors that other Paebala escaped from the tunnels. Well, Minki wants to leave too!' He lets out a defeated sigh. 'Aieee. Minki tried talking to other Paebala in the tunnels, but they are too scared to escape. Minki's brother is the same. They're all afraid that Vaniki or Zlandicar will find and kill us. But now Minki knows about this place called [Luclin]! Minki thinks we will all be safe there. Now, Minki just needs to tell Rinki the good news! If Minki brings a group of [strong] adventurers, maybe Rinki will be brave enough to leave.'
You say, 'Luclin isn't exactly safe....'
Drifter Minki lets out a tiny gasp. 'Kweeee! Do you not think so? Well... it must better than living in a tunnel and being forced to fight our cursed brethren all day. Do you not think so?' Minki's whiskers twitch while he ponders your warning. 'Well, if Minki and Rinki are together, nothing on Luclin can stop us! Now I just need to get Rinki, yiyiyi.'
You say, 'I'm pretty strong.'
Drifter Minki gives you a thumbs up. 'Minki thinks so too! You look eya strong!' He takes his bag off his back and peers into it, then frowns. 'Aieee. Minki cannot repay you. All Minki has is cheese.' He thinks for a moment. 'Ika! The Paebala and Chetari always dig up items in the tunnels. If you come with me, you can keep what you find. It will be a tough mission, but Minki thinks it will be worth your while! What do you think? Will you [come with Minki]?'
You have received a request timer for 'Risky Rat Rescue': 0d:1h:0m remaining.
You have been assigned the task 'Risky Rat Rescue'.
You say, 'come with Minki'
Drifter Minki says, 'Aakaka, Minki is so happy. Together, we can navigate the tunnels and find Minki's brother. Then, Minki and Rinki can travel the world and live peacefully.'
LOADING, PLEASE WAIT...
You have entered Dragon Necropolis: Risky Rat Rescue.
You end up not far from the rat tunnels at /loc 316, -1513, -12
1. Tell Minki you're ready to begin the rescue mission 0/1
You say, 'Hail, Minki'
Minki says, 'Aakaka, thank you again for coming with Minki. You make Minki feel eya pallo with your kindness. Minki has a good sniffer, so we will sniff our way to Rinki. But, aieee, these are dangerous tunnels. Chetari territory. You will have to protect Minki while Minki uses sniffer. Please let Minki know when you are prepared to [depart] and we will begin.'
You say, 'Let us depart.'
Minki gives two thumbs up. 'Let us go. Please follow Minki closely. If you want to leave at any time, just tell Minki! Tila, be careful around the spiders. They do not think rats are very tasty, but maybe they will feel differently about you. Hopefully they do not notice you.'
2. Delve into the underground tunnels with Minki 0/1
Follow Minki until you receive an update around location  350, -1375, -239.
3. Defend against the Chetari scavengers 0/4 Dragon Necropolis
At this point, six a Chetari scavenger [npc=57588] spawn, Four nearby all on top of each other. Currently they see through invisibility, IVU, and SOS (though this is probably a bug). They can be mezed, rooted, and snared.  Kill 4 of them.

4. Tell Minki it's safe to continue 0/1 Dragon Necropolis
Minki says, 'Kwee! Thank you for protecting Minki. But now, Minki needs your help picking a [direction]....'

Kill 5 a Chetari raider [npc=57585].

Rinki looks at you and Minki with pain in his eyes. 'Minki!? Ika! Mi za'ka thwam. Na Chetari wo nikao muma. Se... Rinki za'bu wue fwee.' Rinki doubles over, clutching his stomach. 'Rinki does not feel so good. Rinki was so hungry and ate some dragon meat. Rinki thinks that was a [bad] idea....'
You say, 'bad'
Rinki's teeth grow longer. His body makes awful snapping and crunching noises as it grows larger. Rinki howls in pain. His eyes focus on you. They are dark and glazed over, unlike the Rinki who had been speaking to you only moments earlier.

Not only did you kill Endsa, you also rescued the cheese! Minki is eya grateful for you, yiyiyi. Now, let us follow the trail to my [brother].'
