# Tempest Festival: Here Comes the Rain

**Level:** 1 | **Maximum Level:** 130 | **Quest Type:** Task | **Repeatable:** Yes | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 1
**Maximum Level:** 130
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** Yes
**Can Be Shrouded?:** No
**Quest Type:** Task
**Group Size:** Solo

This is a Karana: Tempest Festival event task that runs in late April to Early May.
You can obtain this quest from speaking with Rosalind Mischeva in Plane of Knowledge on the west side of the zone near the pond. She is on the find tool CTRL F.
You say, 'Hail, Rosalind Mischeva'
Rosalind Mischeva says, 'Hail and well met. I do so enjoy a late [spring rain]. Make sure you take a moment and bask in the rain. I do so miss the [sounds of rain] during the summertime.'
You say, 'Late spring rain? I have noticed that it has been raining more than normal.'
Rosalind Mischeva says, '[The Tempest] blessed us with the Throne of Thunder and now he blesses us with soft rain. You should rejoice and sing his praises.'
You say, 'The Tempest is Karana correct?'
Rosalind Mischeva says, 'Yes, his voice is gentle on [the wind] and brings the end of spring. It is the time for the crops to grow and for the storms to ebb.'
You say, 'What does the wind say?'
Rosalind Mischeva says, 'I dare not speak for the Rainkeeper, but I hear that it has been raining in most of the cities. Perhaps you [could gather] the rain and return it to the sacred pond?'
You say, 'I could gather the rain and take it. Just let me know where to go.'
You have been assigned the task 'Here Comes the Rain'.
Rosalind Mischeva says, 'I have marked down all the cities to visit and gather the rain. Here is a vessel to gather the rain. Make sure you center yourself before trying to collect the rain. Once the carafe has been filled take it to the sacred pool.'
You are given: Empty Tempest Carafe
All you need to do is zone into the below zones, target yourself and right click Empty Tempest Carafe.
An easy way of doing this is to just bind yourself in Plane of Knowledge and use the stones to get to each city.
They can be done in any order.
Hint: Save South Qeynos, Surefall Glade, and Jaggedpine for last. That way you can go to them one after the other and then just zone back into Surefall glade for the last step.

This is part of the Karana Tempest Events that runs between late April and early May.
You can obtain this task from Ralph Mischeva in Jaggedpine Forest. He can be found at /waypoint +295,-1786.
You say, 'Hail, Ralph Mischeva'
Ralph Mischeva says, 'Hear me and rejoice. The Tempest is no gentle storm, he is a righteous squalling force. [Celebrate] and be awed by his power. All should cower and [fear him].'
You say, 'I don't fear him. Why should I?'
Ralph Mischeva says, 'Because his power can reshape this land. The storm does not stop and think about what is in its path. We should be in awe and [respect his] power.'
You say, 'I respect his power, even if I do not fear it.'

You have been assigned the task 'Felled by the Rain'.
Ralph Mischeva says, 'Great, there are siroccos near here. They carry the virgae stones. You can use these stones to summon a virga. Defeat the virgae and show the Tempest that you are a contender.'

**Level:** 115 | **Maximum Level:** 125 | **Quest Type:** Task | **Repeatable:** Yes | **Monster Mission:** No

**Maximum Level:** 125
**Monster Mission:** No

**Group Size:** Solo

This is a seasonal quest that occurs during the Tempest Festival event in early May.
You can obtain this quest from Ralph Mischeva in Jaggedpine Forest at 294, -1781, -13. He is on the find tool CTRL F.
You say, 'Hail, Ralph Mischeva'
Ralph Mischeva says, 'Hear me and rejoice. The Tempest is no gentle storm, he is a righteous squalling force. [Celebrate] and be awed by his power. All should cower and [fear him].'
You say, 'I have come to celebrate Karana's power.'
Ralph Mischeva says, 'The storm rages on. Do you dare [challenge] it?'
You say, 'I will challenge the storm.'
Ralph Mischeva says, 'The storms cannot be stopped but they can be appeased. If you can, [fight the rains] and your name will be carried upon the winds.'
You say, 'I will fight the rains.'
You have been assigned the task 'Reign of Rain'.
Ralph Mischeva says, 'May the Tempest bless your path.'
Ralph Mischeva believes in the awesome power of the Tempest. He has tasked you with defeating the rain elementals to provie your might.
Defeat the rain elementals.
- 1. Defeat 20 rain elementals 0/20
There are variant types of rain elementals (a drained rain elemental, a weak rain elemental, a surging rain elemental, to the north and south of Ralph Mischeva, along the river. They vary from Level 90 to Level 94, do not see invis, average hit around 9k on a tank merc but can hit as hard as 50K+, and have a load of Hit Points. Kill 20 of them.
Map File Locations of the above elementals: Put these in your jaggedpine_1.txt map file.

These spawn very quickly after being killed so make sure to pull them away from their spawn point.
- 2. Defeat the bursting rain elemental 0/1 Jaggedpine Forest
Once the first step is done, a bursting rain elemental (level 94) will span just north of Ralph Mischeva (Your location is 545.47, -1774.44, -11.84). Kill it.
- 3. Defeat the swell of Karana 0/1 Jaggedpine Forest
Once a bursting rain elemental, a swell of Karana (Level 96) will spawn to the southwest, run in and attack you. Kill it.
- 4. Report to Ralph about your success 0/1 Jaggedpine Forest

# 25th Anniversary: Chasing Madness

**Level:** 100 | **Maximum Level:** 130 | **Quest Type:** Task | **Repeatable:** Yes | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 100
**Maximum Level:** 130
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** Yes
**Can Be Shrouded?:** No
**Quest Type:** Task
**Group Size:** Solo

This task starts with Ghrald McMannus in Katta Castellum. He can be found at /way -301, 150, 69 in the big castle in the northwest section of the zone, up on the 2nd floor in one of the rooms on the south side.
You say, 'Hail, Ghrald McMannus'
Ghrald McMannus says, 'Thank you for your diligence in finding us. I don't think I told you that before.' He lets out a hearty sigh and looks with concern over towards Gaius. 'I am at the whims of Gaius' flights of fancy, in hopes that one might lead us to the answer, yet I protect him from anything that may harm him in our [pursuit].'
You say, 'What is your pursuit?'
Ghrald McMannus says, 'I mentioned before that I think this may be the work of the gods, or a god, but we need some information to try to narrow it down. Whether they have made themselves known to Gaius, he hasn't stated, but I have some potential [sources] of knowledge we can research.'
You say, 'What sources are you looking into?'
Ghrald McMannus says, 'There are some books regarding visions of various types and the madness that can accompany them. Frankly our history is wrought with examples of various gods affecting fragile mortal minds. A simple touch can do so much to you or me. Would you mind trying to [gather] these books for our research?'
You say, 'I will gather the books.'
You have been assigned the task 'Chasing Madness'.
Ghrald McMannus says, 'Excellent. I appreciate your attention to this. There are two books in particular to look for. One is in the possession of an old acquaintance of mine, Rusbek, in the Misty Thicket. If you give his pups a bite to eat, he might let you know where to find it. He might not entertain giving it up otherwise, and for that I apologize in advance. The other book is one I had been reading in the New Tanaan library. When word came of Gaius' condition, I left rather swiftly, so it was left on one of the tables. It may still be there if no one's restored it back to its shelf.'
Ghrald McMannus' friend Gaius Ludanus, an adherent to Drinal the Silver Reaper, has fallen mad under some visions that have started to make themselves known to everyone around them. So far, no one has been hurt but many have gone mad in the process of his travels and in the presence of the small baby dragons that have started popping up in the realms of Norrath and Ludin.
Ghrald indicated that giving some treats to Rusbek's wolves should allow you to gain Rusbek’s trust to get your hands on the book he is in the possession of. Ghrald informed you that the book he’s looking for in the New Tanaan library should be on a table there if it hadn’t been put back.
- 1. Give one of Rusbek's Wolves a delicious treat 0/1 Misty Thicket
Go to Misty Thicket. You can find Rusbek the Inhospitable. He is in the southeaster corner of the zone near a couple of cottages with his 2 wolves. Give one of his wolves any food, I don't think it matters what it is as long as it is food.
You offered 1 Iron Ration to Cozy.
Rusbek the Inhospitable says, 'Well, that's kind of you, I guess. I'm guessing you're here to sweeten us up for the book? It's inside, in the back. Just, uh, make sure our mutual friend keeps HIS friend away from Misty Thicket.'
Your task 'Chasing Madness' has been updated.
You complete the trade with Cozy.
- 2. Head into Rusbek's cottage to get the book When Obsessions Turn to Madness 0/1 Misty Thicket
Quest Text: Rusbek has indicated the book you're looking for is inside his house. Ghrald informed you that the book he's looking for in the New Tannan library should be on a table there is it hadn't been put back.
Go into the cottage that Rusbek is standing in front of. One the dresser is an open book, click on it to loot When Obssessions Turn to Madness.
Your task 'Chasing Madness' has been updated.
- 3. Pick up the book From Madness Comes Clarity in the New Tannan library 0/1 The Plane of Knowledge
Quest Text: Ghrald informed that the book he's looking for in the New Tannan library should be on a table there if it hadn't been put back. With the book When Obsessions Turn to Madness now in your possession, it's time to take it to Ghrald McMannus.
The book is located on the table at /way -105, 836, 74 in the library next to Tomeseeker Salkien, near where the Ranger spells are sold, at the base of the stairs going to the next floor. It's the smaller book by itself and not in the stacked books.
Your task 'Chasing Madness' has been updated.
- 4. Give When Obsessions Turn to Madness to Ghrald McMannus 0/1 Katta Castellum
Quest Text: With the book When Obsessions Turn to Madness now in your possession, its time to take it to Ghrald McMannus. With the book From Madness Comes Clarity now in your possession, its time to talk it to Ghrald McMannus.
You offered 1 When Obsessions Turn to Madness to Ghrald McMannus.
Your task 'Chasing Madness' has been updated.
Ghrald McMannus says, 'Ah, I will have to thank Rusbek later for taking good care of this text.'
You complete the trade with Ghrald McMannus.
- 5. Give From Madness Comes Clarity to Ghrald McMannus 0/1 Katta Castellum
You offered 1 From Madness Comes Clarity to Ghrald McMannus.
Your task 'Chasing Madness' has been updated.
Ghrald McMannus says, 'You found it! With so many books in the Library, I worried it might have been a tough find.'
You complete the trade with Ghrald McMannus.
- 6. Check In with Ghrald McMannus 0/1 Katta Castellum
You say, 'Hail, Ghrald McMannus'
Ghrald McMannus skims through the text of the first book, then swiftly flips the other book on top to cross-reference some of the data. 'I'm afraid I have a lot to ingest here. I do have some [requests] to see if we can fill in some blanks.'
You say, 'What requests are those?'
Ghrald McMannus says, 'I'd like for you to reach out to a few planar representatives of gods who may be involved. First, a Priest of Terris Thule in the Plane of Nightmare. From there, a Priest of Saryrn in the Plane of Torment. If you still can't find exactly what you're looking for, seek a Priest of Ayonae Ro in what was once the Plane of Music. [And then]...'
You say, 'And then?'
Your task 'Chasing Madness' has been updated.
Ghrald McMannus says, 'Zebuxoruk wishes for no worshippers, so finding one, even a priest, may be difficult. You may have better luck seeking the Ungod out directly, if you can figure out WHEN to seek him out...'
- 7. Speak with a Priest of Nightmares in the Plane of Nightmare 0/1 The Plane Nightmare
Quest Text: Speak with a Priest of Terris-Thule's in the Plane of Nightmare for any information as to this mystery.
Priest of Nightmares [npc=59879] is located at -1351, -1350, 124 in the far southeastern section of the zone in the graveyard in the middle building. He's on Find (Ctrl+F).
Be ready for this step, it spawns a mad nightmare [npc=59882] that attacks. it's fairly weak (level 106) for players 120+. About 6 million hp and doesn't hit for very much. It drops an item, give it to all in the group in the task.
You say, 'Hail, Priest of Nightmares'
Priest of Nightmares says, 'Quiet. I am trying to [sleep].'
You say, 'You are trying to sleep standing up?'
Priest of Nightmares says, 'It's the best way to ensure I fall to the ground to wake myself from the nightmare. It's a beautiful and terrifying [cycle].'
You say, 'Why the cycle?'
Priest of Nightmares says, 'Some of the delicious terror is in trying to go back to sleep with those nightmarish [visions] freshly intruding into your mind. Will you find yourself in the same horrifying situations, or will more seek to disrupt your hours of rest?'
You say, 'I've come to find a priest about visions.'
Priest of Nightmares says, 'Do you also want to sleep in horror? Do you want to [see things] that will scare your very soul?'
You say, 'It's for a friend. They see things fully awake.'
Priest of Nightmares says, 'The mind can wander. Intrusive thoughts can terrify you randomly through your mundane life. What would happen if your mount were to run over a squirrel? Is there a mimic in your outhouse? If you punch the barkeep, how many bones can you break?' He falls into a horrible laughter, the sickening tones catching in his throat shrilly. 'Those are not nightmares, silly mortal. Waking visions are not our [concern] here.'
You say, 'They are our concern.'
Priest of Nightmares says, 'Very well then. Fight my friend, and he may carry a clue to help you piece together your answer. Know that it is not the Dream Scorcher, for she seeks the slumbering. Oh, little nightmare...!'
A mad nightmare laughs at the sight of the adventurer and his eyes widen as he rushes forth!
Your task 'Chasing Madness' has been updated.
You gain party experience! (0.003%)
A mad nightmare's corpse returns to the Nightmares from which he arose.
- 8. Loot a Dash of Fear from a mad nightmare 0/1 The Plane of Nightmare
Loot Dash of Fear [item=148901] from a mad nightmare's corpse.
A Dash of Fear was given to you.
--You have looted a Dash of Fear from a mad nightmare's corpse.--
- 9. Speak with a Priest of Pain in Torment, the Plane of Pain 0/1 Torment, the Plane of Pain
Quest Text: Speak with a Priest of Saryrn's in Torment, the Plane of Pain for any information as to this mystery.
Be ready in this step, another mobs spawns and attacks. It's weak as well though.
Priest of Pain [npc=59880] is located at +515,+353,-156 in the west central part of the zone. He's on Find (Ctrl+F).
You say, 'Hail, Priest of Pain'
Priest of Pain says, 'Oh. You here for [pain]?'
You say, 'No, not pain exactly.'
Priest of Pain says, 'Pain is glorious sensation. To feel pain is to know the Tormentor. To feel pain is to know beautiful [madness].'
You say, 'Yes, I am here about madness.'
Priest of Pain says, 'Are you? Madness is not our Tormentor's [domain].'
You say, 'Whose domain is it?'
Priest of Pain rumbles in amusement. 'You should already know.'
A mad torment skitters rapidly to its target!
Your task 'Chasing Madness' has been updated.
You gain party experience! (0.003%)
A mad torment's corpse returns to the Torment from which it arose.
- 10. Loot a Dollop of Insanity from a mad torment 0/1 Torment, the Plane of Pain
Loot Dollop of Insanity [item=148902] from a mad torment's corpse.
A Dollop of Insanity was given to you.
--You have looted a Dollop of Insanity from a mad torment's corpse.--
Your task 'Chasing Madness' has been updated.
- 11. Speak with a Priestess of Music in the Theater of Blood 0/1 Theater of Blood
Quest Text: Speak with a Priestess of Ayonae Ro's in the Theater of Blood for any information as to this mystery.
Another mobs spawns with this step, same level and strength. Loot the item from its corpse.
You say, 'Hail, Priestess of Music'
Priestess of Music says, 'Ah, a sane soul! With Mayong's loss of divinity, it is so comforting to see another here not touched by his power. What [brings] you to the recovering Demi-Plane of Music?'
You say, 'Ayonae Ro's status brings me. Is she well?'
Priestess of Music says, 'The Maestra continues to recover in her tower! We appreciate your concern, friendly mortal, and will pass your well wishes along. With this Demi-Plane a manifestation of her music, will, and experiences, it will take some time to return to something untouched by the former Blood God's [influence].'
You say, 'The influence will be felt by many for some time.'
Priestess of Music says, 'Yes. The [madness] he put her through in order to take and twist her Demi-Plane... His was but borrowed power and this Theater but a borrowed Plane.'
You say, 'What can you tell me of her madness?'
Priestess of Music says, 'It was but a tool to create for Mayong. The madness originated with him, but the Demi-Plane you see here is still her song. She has changed the key and the tempo, but that doesn't change that we still must [reach] the codetta before moving on.'
You say, 'May she reach it in her time.'
Priestess of Music agrees, 'Everything in time. You have a friend who is suffering madness, yes? Please, help me help a friend move on to their part in the next verse, and perhaps they can help you in your own way.' She calls an old friend.
A mad griever stares with wide, begging eyes.
Your task 'Chasing Madness' has been updated.

--You have looted a Smidgen of Loss from a mad griever's corpse.--
Your task 'Chasing Madness' has been updated.
The Smidgen of Loss wrenches at your heart, but it sounds as though it will fit in this puzzle.
- 13. Speak with Zebuxoruk in the Void 0/1 The Void
Quest Text: Speak with Zebuxoruk the Ungod in The Void for any information as to this mystery.
This step, you need to go to The Void that's off of Ethernere Tainted West Karana.
You say, 'Hail, Zebuxoruk'
Zebuxoruk says, 'You come again. Who do you propose made his visions this time? You take on the experiences of your life, your experiences of every battle you have fought, and the challenges that you have won and conquered. Have you met her this cycle? No, no, for she is illusive, isn't she? Through timelines I have seen you help Gaius, and I have seen you fail, and I have seen you succeed, yet you have yet to find her before you seek me, don't you? In any case, take this, as I know you'll need it, as you have before.'

The Pinch of Foresight may be what completes this mysterious recipe.

Quest Text: With several "ingredients" now in hand, speak with Ghrald McMannus back in Katta Castellum for his recommendations from here.
You offered 1 Pinch of Foresight to Ghrald McMannus.
Before the pieces of this mysterious recipe could be examined, the individual collections coalesce into a vision. Instead of dragons or the man in white that already stands physically near them, a vision of another demi-goddess graces their collective view.
Vision of Vazaelle says, 'It's so fun to see your favorite things all the time, isn't it? So very, very, very fun.'
And then with a scream that reverberates through the room, she's gone, as though she never was there. Gaius seems unaffected, but Ghrald is visibly shaken.
Ghrald McMannus says, 'Adventurer! I believe I know what we need to do with these ingredients now. Come back to me in a bit, and I will have more information for you.'
Your task 'Chasing Madness' has been updated.

# Rathe Day: Owlbear with Me for a Moment

**Level:** 1 | **Maximum Level:** 130 | **Quest Type:** Task | **Repeatable:** Yes | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 1
**Maximum Level:** 130
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** Yes
**Can Be Shrouded?:** No
**Quest Type:** Task
**Group Size:** Solo

Korah Kai [npc=59932] is located at +1001,+1948,+32.88 in Hollowshade Moor. She's on Find (Ctrl+F).
You say, 'Hail, Korah Kai'
Korah Kai's ears perk up as you greet her. 'Oh! An adventurer! Just the type of person I could use for my work. Tell me, what do you know about [conservation]?'
You say, 'As in, the conservation of mana? I've heard of it.'
Korah Kai snickers at your response, 'No, silly! While that is also an important study, I'm talking about the conservation of our lands. Nature conservation falls within the realms of the gods, but even they can use some help from time to time. We only have one Norrath and we need to make sure it remains here for future generations. Part of this effort involves basically, well, stalking animals without them spotting you and seeing what they do. Recently, I discovered during my last outing that the [owlbears] that I have been documenting have decreased in numbers greatly from their nest. I believe that they have started a migration.'
You say, 'Owlbears you say?'
Korah Kai gives you a wink. 'Yes! Owlbears! Everybody loves owlbears. Two things that I have observed with owlbears is that they primarily nest on Luclin, and they almost have a supernatural charisma about them. Nobody hates owlbears. Even poachers who have endangered their existence in the past have a strange respect for them that you wouldn't see with any other exotic creature. Because of this, owlbears nest in extremely secluded places. Their packs also excel in obfuscation, which is what makes them so elusive. There have been events on Luclin that have unearthed an ancient owlbear spirit. Ever since then, the owlbears of Luclin have grown [restless].'
You say, 'Restless? Do you think they changed their behavior because of this event?'
Korah Kai gives a nod. 'I do. I think with this release of this spirit, their temperament shifted from being very docile to-' she pauses to try to find the right words, '-well I can't say "aggressive," but they seem more ambitious. Owlbears are also considered a "capstone species" as they are an indicator of what is happening to the wildlife around them. If things are becoming unsustainable for the area, they are one of the first species to find a new place for food and shelter. Luckily, not all of them seem to have migrated this time. This being the [first migration], I suspect they understood that sending everyone to find a new home may not be a good idea. Fascinating creatures!'
You say, 'If this is their first migration, where are they going?'
Korah Kai smiles. It is clear this is something she loves to talk about, especially with new people. 'I'm so glad you asked! That is a wonderful question. Some avian species have a sort of [magical compass] that causes them to migrate to other locations far away from their home even without having been there before. It's a natural instinct. Typically they do it to take advantage of changes in climate and food resources. Some even migrate just like one would to a vacation home or how adventurers "migrate" because they do not like being in one place for too long.' She chuckles.
You say, 'Magical compass?'
Korah Kai says, 'With this being Norrath, there can be a multitude of reasons for why creatures do what they do. It's important to understand our actions can cause great peril to some creatures. For instance, there was a strange blast of energy that blasted off of Norrath some time ago, and it caused entire shrieker populations in the Paludal Caverns to start crying out for days. This made it easier for their natural predators to find them and many colonies were wiped out. This upset the natural [balance] and had devastating consequences.'
You say, 'What happened after the balance was upset?'
You have been assigned the task 'Owlbear with Me for a Moment'.
Korah Kai says, 'There simply wasn't enough food and many of those predators who gorged themselves ended up starving to death. It took some time and the work of many druids to restore the balance there lest the problem spread. With all this being said, I implore you to track down the pack of owlbears and find out where their new nest is. I would suggest that you search the paths leading to nearby locations for any clues for which way they could have went.'
The moonquake that shook Luclin has caused more than just a ruckus for the inhabitants of Shadow Haven. The owlbears have started a migration that they have never done before. Korah Kai has been observing the owlbears in their natural habitat and this behavior is new to her research. She has tasked you with tracking the owlbear migration across Luclin and locating where they could have gone.
- 1. Locate which way the owlbear's migration went first 0/1 Hollowshade Moor
Norah Kai has asked that you attempt to locate which direction the owlbears started their journey. Look near this area's entrances and exits for any clues as to which way they could have gone.
Head toward the northeast cave leading to Grimling Forest. Right before the cave entrance are patches of fur, click one of them.
You located a piece of owlbear tuft near the direction of the Grimling Forest. Bring this to Korah Kai for inspection.
- 2. Return to Korah Kai and give her what you found 0/1 Hollowshade Moor
Give the Cold Owlbear Tuft to Korah Kai.
You offered 1 Cold Owlbear Tuft to Korah Kai.
You have been given: Owlbear Migration Samples Pouch
Korah Kai smiles warmly as you hand her the tuft. 'This dander is what the owlbears leave behind when they are going through various stages of their molting. Many avian species also have a "winter coat' that they have to deal with every season. In this case though, they are still doing that even while migrating. That is fascinating to know. So we know that they will leave their debris near the exits/entrances of different locations along the way of their migration.' She thinks for a moment before continuing. 'Well, where did they go after the Grimling Forest? Oh adventurer, I must ask you to continue your search and see if you can find where they ended up. Here, take this pouch so you can gather any more dander you may find. I will need you to collect all sorts of gross things. Conservation can be a bit disgusting at times but worth it for understanding our world.'
- 3. Locate the next leg of the owlbear migration 0/1 Grimling Forest
Clearly the path shows that the owlbears went to the Grimling Forest, but where did they go after that? Look for clues for which way the went next.
Head toward the northeast cave in Grimling Forest leading to Tenebrous Mountains. Right before the cave entrance are feathers, pick one of them.
- 4. Track where the owlbears went next 0/1 The Tenebrous Mountains
You realized that there is only one direction the owlbears could have gone from this location, and that would be toward Katta Castellum.
Head toward the Katta Castellum entrance in the center west part of the Tenebrous Mountains. Wizards and druids may want to use their evac spell to get there faster.
You can almost smell the owlbears. They have gone into this area but clearly they could not have gone the same path you are following. They must have found a different path around Katta Castellum, but still went in that direction. Follow them through and see if you can catch up with them on the other side of Katta Castellum.
- 5. Continue to follow the owlbears 0/1 The Twilight Sea
The owlbears seemed to have gone to the Twilight Sea. From there, find out the next leg of their migration.
Head toward the castle where the portal to Fungus Grove is. Before the castle, around /way -1065,+228,-22 you'll find Warm Owlbear Droppings, pick one of them.
The droppings you found are very fresh. The owlbear migration must be close by. You are thankful that Korah gave you a pouch for this. It's clear they couldn't have gone this way, but they somehow may have gone to the Fungus Grove. Follow their trail.
- 6. Discover the next stop for the owlbears 0/1 The Fungus Grove
Head to Fungus Grove through the portal at the top of the castle. Once inside, go straight away, down, and a pick a Moist Owlbear Down on the bridge around /way 1977, 1728, -122.
You pick up the pinions and they are not only warm but still damp with the oils that owlbears use to waterproof their bodies. You look up to see in the distance that there is a nest of owlbears settling in, unbothered by the surrounding creatures. You feel it best to keep your distance and return to Korah Kai with your findings.
- 7. Return to Korah Kai and tell her where the migration ended 0/1 Hollowshade Moor
You say, 'Hail, Korah Kai'
Korah Kai says, 'Conservation is everyone's responsibility. There is only one Norrath. I intend to remind people of that.'
You say, 'The migration ended in the Fungus Grove'
You have been given: Cold Owlbear Tuft
Korah Kai says, 'Of course they would choose that place for their final nesting spot! It's safe, secluded, and they already have a relationship with the critters who call that cave home. Thank you for tracking their migration pattern. I can use that information for my own further studies. Speaking of which, let me give you back this tuft and if you could secure it with everything else inside that pouch I gave you, I would be grateful.'
- 8. Secure the pouch for Korah 0/1 ALL
Inside the Owlbear Migration Samples Pouch, combine Fresh Owlbear Pinions, Warm Owlbear Droppings, Moist Owlbear Down and Cold Owlbear Tuft.
You have learned the recipe Secure the Owlbear Samples pouch!
You have fashioned the items together to create something new: Secured Migration Samples Pouch.
You secure the collections in the pouch. Much to your delight, there was a small container with cleaner to wash your hands afterwards. Everything is in place now. Return the pouch to Korah.
- 9. Give Korah Kai the pouch 0/1 Hollowshade Moor
The migration pattern of the Luclin owlbear has been documented for future years. This information is useful for remembering our actions can alter conservation. Though it seems that Korah has another task for you.
Korah Kai takes the pouch and examines its contents, ensuring everything is in order before speaking. 'Perfect! Thank you adventurer! You don't realize now, but the work you did here today will help shade the understanding of these wonderful creatures for centuries to come. I will continue my observations into their changing behavior.' She has the largest grin you've ever seen someone have while talking about owlbears. 'I can't wait to get this documented! I may have more work for you if you think yourself brave enough.'
The next task in this series is Rathe Day: Softer than Othmir Fur [quest=12921]

Lost Owlbear PupRewards:

# Rathe Day: Softer than Othmir Fur

**Level:** 1 | **Maximum Level:** 125 | **Quest Type:** Task | **Repeatable:** Yes | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 1
**Maximum Level:** 125
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** Yes
**Can Be Shrouded?:** No
**Quest Type:** Task
**Group Size:** Solo

This task is a continuation of the Rathe Day tasks after completing Owlbear with Me for a Moment [quest=12920]. You can get the task from Korah Kai [npc=59932], she is located at +1001,+1948,+32.88 in Hollowshade Moor. She's on Find (Ctrl+F).
You say, 'Hail, Korah Kai'
Korah Kai says, 'The elusive owlbears could use some extra documentation tracking on their migration. It isn't like there's such thing as too much documentation. Remember what happened to the shriekers and maintaining [balance]? Or would you be interested in helping me with a different set of [beasts]?'
You say, 'I can help with these other beasts.'
You have been assigned the task 'Softer than Othmir Fur'.
Korah Kai smiles warmly as you ask. 'I'm so glad you are still interested in conservation, Kenadi! There are many aspects of it, and as you have already noticed, sometimes it can be a bit gross. However, it's all for a good reason, as we can learn a lot about the lands surrounding these creatures by studying the creatures themselves. I have an associate who absolutely loves the wildlife on Norrath and could use your help. His name is Reeve Purewing, and you can find him somewhere in West Karana. Speak with him for more details for what he needs help with.' She giggles, 'If you are brave enough, that is.'
Korah is happy you are willing to continue to help her with her work. She wants you to assist her associate Reeve Purewing with whatever help he may need.
- 1. Find Korah’s colleague 0/1 The Western Plains of Karana
Korah has sent you to West Karana to locate her associate, Reeve Purewing. Meet up with him and hear what he has to say.
Reeve Purewing [npc=59934] can be found in the northwest part of West Karana at /way +484,-4299.
You say, 'Hail, Reeve Purewing'
Reeve Purewing's thick accent is hard to place and even harder to understand. His energy is very intoxicating and you can't but help to be as excited as he is right now. 'G'day adventurer! I am so very glad to see ya! Aye! Korah was right in sending you to me! I am in need of someone brave like you for some work. Listen-' he pauses for a moment and cups his ear with his hand. 'Ya don't hear it like I do, but the land has been changed here in Karana, especially with the critters that call this place home. One such critter is as gentle as othmir fur once you know how to handle them. The problem is that they ain't [native] to these lands and nobody here knows how to handle them. Luckily, they have found a new home in a place that can handle them the way they need to be handled, the Plane of Fear.'
- 2. Collect a fresh ursticating hair 0/1 The Southern Plains of Karana
The ursarachnids from Ethemere have upset the balance of Karana and the surrounding areas by creating nests and preying on the local wildlife. Reeve has assured you that the ursarachnids are softer than othmir fur, if one knows how to handle them properly. Reeve has been tracking the spider-bears, but his arachnophobia is making it difficult to work closely with the creatures. He asks that you help him with his work clearing up the ursarachnids who haven’t moved on from their nesting grounds. He is a very passionate individual and he is very excited to have someone to help him with the ursarachnids. He needs your help with collecting and documenting how the areas of South Karana, Lake Rathetear, and the Rathe Mountains have affected the ursarachnids. Collect "ursticating" hairs from the ursarachnids in those zones.
These mobs look like spider bears and can be found in the south western part of the zone around /way -6011, 2411, 9
Kill them until they drop Ursticating Hairs from South Karana [item=149038].
--You have looted an Ursticating Hairs from South Karana from a nesting ursarachnid's corpse.--
Your task 'Softer than Othmir Fur' has been updated.
- 3. Collect a fresh ursticating hair 0/1 Lake Rathtear
You can find the same spider bears in Lake Rathe around /way 3458, -1258, -1 northwest of the Rathe Mountains zoneline. Kill them and loot Ursticating Hairs from Lake Rathetear [item=149039].
- 4. Collect a fresh ursticating hair 0/1 The Rathe Mountains
You can find the same spider bears in The Rathe Mountains around /way 2689, 642, -10 to the south east of the Lake Rathe zoneline. Kill them and loot Ursticating Hairs from Rathe Mountains [item=149040].
- 5. Meet back up with Reeve 0/1 The Western Plains of Karana
Reeve Purewing  ignores you for a moment, as you caught him in another moment of him seriously staring off into the distance. Eventually he shifts back to his jolly side again. 'You made it back with the hairs? Perfect, my friend! This is exactly what I was looking for. As you did with Korah, please take this binder and document your findings.'
You say, 'Hail, Reeve Purewing'
You have been given: Ursticating Hairs Binder [item=149041]
Your task 'Softer than Othmir Fur' has been updated.
- 6. Secure the hairs in the binder 0/1 ALL
Open the Ursticating Hairs Binder and put in Ursticating Hairs from South Karana, Ursticating Hairs from Lake Rathetear, and Ursticating Hairs from Rathe Mountains. Hit combine.
You have learned the recipe Document the hairs in the binder!
You have fashioned the items together to create something new: Documented Ursticating Hairs Binder [item=149042].
Your task 'Softer than Othmir Fur' has been updated.
You secure each hair firmly into the binder. You notice that each spot is already labeled and waiting for you to simply collect a sample of the hair. Reeve has put a lot of love into this. He will be elated for you to give this back to him.
- 7. Give Reeve back his binder 0/1 The Western Plains of Karana
You offered 1 Documented Ursticating Hairs Binder to Reeve Purewing.
Your task 'Softer than Othmir Fur' has been updated.
Reeve Purewing opens the binder to check your work. He seems satisfied. 'Look at these specimens, they are perfect. You can certainly tell where they are from. It's fascinating to know how some of these creatures adapt to the environment around them. That being said, we have one more task left. The ursarachnids found a way to the Plane of Fear, but in the Feerrott, many have laid eggs in the area. What you need to do is cull the ursarachnids found in the Feerrott and try to locate one intact spiderling egg that looks close to hatching. Bring that here and I will be able to continue documenting these beautiful creatures?'
You complete the trade with Reeve Purewing.
- 8. Locate an ursarachnid egg 0/1 The Feerrott
Reeve has asked for your help in one more task involving the ursarachnids. He has asked you to collect a spider-bear egg that looks like it may hatch soon. Find it and return as soon as possible with it.
You can find these eggs on the left side of the left fork of the river on the south end around /way -1232, 929, -13. Click on one to loot Incubated Ursarachnid Egg [item=149043].
- 9. Deliver the egg to Reeve 0/1 The Western Plains of Karana
You offered 1 Incubated Ursarachnid Egg to Reeve Purewing.
Your task 'Softer than Othmir Fur' has been updated.
You have helped Reeve Purewing with his documenting of the ursarachnids in Norrath. He has thanked you and informed you that he no longer has any work he has to do. He has suggested that Korah Kai requires your help. Seek her out in Hollowshade Moor for another task.
You have been given: Imprinted Ursarachnid Hatchling [item=149036]
Reeve Purewing gasps as you hand him the spiderling egg. You see a look of discomfort wash over his eyes, as a moment passes and the egg wriggles in his hands. 'Ew ew ew ew!' he exclaims as he carefully sets the egg on the ground next to him. 'That's enough of that,' he says while wiping his hands on his shirt. 'Didn't need that feeling documented, that's for certain. You see, Gebb, conservation is about the preservation of life, even if we have to destroy it to maintain that balance. We have never had an ursarachnid born in captivity before, and since most of them have found their way to a new home, it would be much easier to study these little guys where it's safe for everyone. I have enough information to continue my work. Please return to Korah Kai, and Gebb, thank you again for everything. You're incredible.'
You complete the trade with Reeve Purewing.
The next task in this series is Rathe Day: Lessons of Luclin Lichen [quest=12922]

You can obtain this 26th anniversary task from Firiona Vie in Shadeweaver's Thicket. She can be found at /way -1699, 2149, -157 (standing next to the Loda Kai Embassy building). She is on the Find Tool CTRL F.
You say, 'Hail, Firiona Vie'
Firiona Vie says, 'Adventurer, I see you have come to look over the jade collection, as well. If I may have a moment of your time, I have a [request] of you.'
You say, 'I will be happy to fulfill a request for you, Lady Firiona Vie.'
Firiona Vie says, 'I appreciate that. I was hoping to find a specific jade [piece] that doesn't seem to be part of this collection. I cannot get into why I need it just yet, but I assure you it's more important than simply wanting to appreciate its artistic qualities.'
You say, 'What piece were you seeking?'
Firiona Vie says, 'There is a one-of-a-kind jade tiger statue, where its uniqueness and inherent power might have made it worthy enough for the display here. We sit disappointed.' Firiona Vie gives a humored smile. 'If you don't mind doing a bit of a treasure [hunt], I can point you to someone who might have a lead as to where it might be.'
You say, 'I'm up for the hunt.'
You have been assigned the task 'Diary of the Jade - The Discovery'.
Firiona Vie says, 'I appreciate your willingness, especially in light of, well, you being in the dark. I apologize for that.' A prepared letter is pulled from a small pack, sealed with wax, and is offered to _____. 'Take this letter to Dreezil Pocketdip in Misty Thicket. I imagine a man of his skills is bound to have a lead on its whereabouts.'
Note: You receive a ‘Letter from Firiona.’
Make sure you buy some Gouda Cheese before you get started on this task.
Tunare's Champion, the Lady Firiona Vie, has requested information on the mythical Jade Tiger statue that wasn't present at the large jade showing in Shadeweaver's Thicket. Her interest in the statue goes beyond collecting, not interested in the superficial elements, there's far more involved in the matter. For Plan B of her search, she has requested that you reach out to her crafty friend Dreezil Stickens for information and see where things take you from there.
Firiona Vie has supplied a letter sealed in wax and stamped with her personal seal. She has entrusted you in bringing the information to her good friend, and oft travel companion, Dreezil "Pocketdip" Stickens.
- 1. Deliver Firiona Vie's letter to Dreezil Stickens 0/1 Misty Thicket
You can find Dreezil Stickens in Misty Thicket at /way -445, 695, 24. He is in the southwestern part of the zone on the west side of the wall, near a tree stump.
You say, 'Hail, Dreezil Stickens'
Dreezil Stickens hisses in an urgent whisper, 'Go 'way. Unless yer here on [urgent] business, I can't talk right now.'
You say, 'It's urgent.'
Dreezil Stickens turns his head to directly face _____. 'What d'ya got?'
You offered 1 Letter from Firiona Vie to Dreezil Stickens.
Your task 'Diary of the Jade - The Discovery' has been updated.
Dreezil Stickens warily takes the letter, and his eyes immediately catch on the seal binding the envelope closed. 'It looks like we 'ave a mutual acquaintance.' Meeting _____s eyes only a brief moment, his attention shifts back to the letter as he breaks the seal and unfolds it. 'Oh. Ooooh. OH! Excellent. I love a good mystery.' He smiles mischeviously and pockets the letter, which will get a nice disposal by fire later. 'But - I [can't help] ye directly. I'm needed 'ere.'
You complete the trade with Dreezil Stickens.
- 2. Get your instructions from Dreezil Stickens 0/1 Misty Thicket
You say, 'You can't help? What do you recommend then?'
Your task 'Diary of the Jade - The Discovery' has been updated.
Dreezil Stickens muses thoughtfully, voice still low, 'Ah, me Lady Firiona has certainly unique an' varied interests.' With a look directly at ______, he answers more on-topic, 'I know someone who might 'ave some clues as to the last known location of the Jade Tiger. Ye'll need to talk to her first. It's a bit of a trek to get there, to a Paebala named Chex in the Dragon Necropolis. So, good luck wi' that, I guess.' Quickly, he adds, 'Bring some gouda.' He turns back towards the near-by camp and his intent surveillance.

This achievement is gained upon finding the following 26th Anniversary hidden items.
A Jade Statue in Shadeweaver's Thicket (Wilton 'Cold Hearted' Draven)
A Jade Statue in Shadeweaver's Thicket (Veynar Aeridia)
A Jade Statue in Shadeweaver's Thicket (Guard Jerith)
A Jade Statue in Shadeweaver's Thicket (Ciradyl Leafwhisper)
A Jade Statue in Shadeweaver's Thicket (Fippy Darkpaw)
A Jade Statue in Shadeweaver's Thicket (Varog)
A Jade Statue in Shadeweaver's Thicket (Bracken Underbrush)
A Jade Statue in Shadeweaver's Thicket (Wyle Bimlin)
A Jade Statue in Shadeweaver's Thicket (Roirk)
A Jade Statue in Shadeweaver's Thicket (Glasson)
A Jade Statue in Shadeweaver's Thicket (Sorceress Gnildaria)
A Jade Statue in Shadeweaver's Thicket (Captain Stonefist)
A Jade Statue in Shadeweaver's Thicket (Clockwork XXIXE)
A Jade Statue in Shadeweaver's Thicket (Dominator Yisaki)
A Jade Statue in Shadeweaver's Thicket (Marda)
/inspect the six jade statues to update the quest. There are three on the 1st floor and three on the top of the tower at /waypoint -1771,+2207,-154.47 in the southwestern part of the zone.
The statues rotate over time every few hours. When rotating, there's an emote:
"A gallery attendant announces, 'Please allow us a moment to rotate our showings. Thank you for your patronage.'"
When inspecting a statue, each has its own description:
- The pirate Wilton 'Cold Hearted' Draven. The gent is said to have earned his nickname by abandoning tardy crew at ports of call to avoid paying them.
- The vampyre Veynar Aeridia [npc=13274]. This vampyre of Luclin origin has made quite a name for himself in the Tenebrous Mountains with the Coterie of the Eternal Night.
- The Qeynos guardsman Guard Jerith [npc=2758]. He is a shining example of the quality we all know and love from the Qeynos guard.
- The Elddar elf Ciradyl Leafwhisper. The woman was known for a large number of controversial bard tunes that made their way through the taverns of Norrath.
- The famous gnoll Fippy Darkpaw [npc=3579]. May he forever be the guiding light, reminding us to never give up.
- The ogre Varog. The Oggok native is known for her shaman skills, but it wasn't herself she was known to be cannibalizing.
- The brownie Bracken Underbrush [npc=6631]. A friend of many woodland folks throughout Faydwer, he was also known to be a bit of a pain in the ankle.
- The merchant Wyle Bimlin [npc=28113]. She's best knows for her Zap Doodle Tonics. The true offense was her not allowing more than one of them at a time.
- The goblin Roirk. He was known far and wide across Antonica for his rigged gambling games. Every roll of the dice is another coin in his coinpurse.
- The satyr Glasson [npc=23715]. Working for the Tuffen, it is believed he was to do severe damage to the Windwillow. His image now stands here as a reminder.
- The grimling Sorceress Gnildaria [npc=7904]. Skilled with the elements upon Luclin, she was quite a challenge, even for the General.
- The coldain dwarf Captain Stonefist [npc=6128]. He might have won more decisively against the Kromrif had he a longer beard.
- The clockwork Clockwork XXIXE. Meldrath the Malignant's forces were strong, with any clockworks siding with the dangerous gnome's schemes.
- The ratman Dominator Yisaki [npc=6501]. Siding with the Chetari of the Dragon Necropolis, this wielder of shadow was a dangerous adversary.
- The ogre Marda [npc=2526]. Intelligent, even amongst those born long after her people were cursed, it doesn't protect her from being on the bad side of a few Norrathians.
Submitted by: iventheassassinRewards:
- Jade-Tinted Spectacles Ornamentation [item=151379]
[

Firiona Vie says, 'I am not entirely sure what happened, but it appears the device malfunctioned or there was some kind of interference in the teleportation. I am not at the same location as you. Did you manage to make it into the thief's [hideout]?'
You say, 'It doesn't look like a cabin in the woods, but these golems look like the same ones guarding the hideout.'
Firiona Vie says, 'At least you recognize the golems. I will try to make my way to you, but it may take me a while. In the meantime, we do not want to squander this [opportunity] to reclaim the idol.'
You say, 'I agree, this may be our only opportunity to get the jump on Boldven.'
Firiona Vie says, 'Good. Then make your way through his hideout and I will figure out a way to reach you. Just be careful, we do not know if he has any traps or additional security lying in wait.'
Your task 'The Great Jade Idol Caper' has been updated.
- 2. Destroy Security Terminal Zero 0/1 Grand Guild Hall
There are these objects located in the back rooms, one is Security Terminal One and the other is Security Terminal Zero.
Security Terminal Zero is in the back left room.
- 3. Defeat Security Bot Mongrop XV Alpha 0/1 Grand Guild Hall
Kill Security Terminal Zero and Mongrop XV Alpha spawns and attacks. Kill it. It has around 155 million HP (level 126 version) and doesn't cast anything.
- 4. Destroy Security Terminal One 0/1 Grand Guild Hall
Security Terminal One is located in the back right room.
- 5. Defeat Security Bot Mongrop XV Beta 0/1 Grand Guild Hall
Kill Security Terminal One and Mongrop XV Beta spawns and attacks. Kill it. It has around 155 million HP (level 126 version) and doesn't cast anything.
- 6. Destroy the Vault Security Terminal 0/1 Grand Guild Hall
Kill it.
- 7. Defeat the first security wave 0/1 Grand Guild Hall
3 a security drone spawn in the back of the room so set your group up on the opposite side where you killed the Vault Security Terminal.
They don't attack and don't see invis. You can pacify and pull them one by one.
- 8. Defeat the second security wave 0/1 Grand Guild Hall
2 a security golems and 2 a security drone spawn in the same place, in the back of the room. Pacify and pull them one by one.
- 9. Defeat the security bot, Grung XV Max 0/1 Grand Guild Hall
On the death of the last mob in that wave, Grung XV Max spawns and attacks. Kill it. Grung XV Max has 310 million HP (level 126) and doesn't cast anything.
- 10. Locate the Jade Tiger Idol 0/1 Grand Guild Hall
Clear out in the room before the Jade Tiger Idol. Once you step into the room, Boldven spawns and attacks.
- 11. Defeat the thief, Boldven 0/1 Grand Guild Hall
Boldven has around 315 million HP (level 126). During the fight he casts a targeted AE called Serrated Blade Barrage. It's a Poison and as a negative resist adjust for Physical -300. Range is 600. It's a dot that does 17.5k damage per tic and lasts for 24 seconds.
It didn't really matter where I put my group, I wasn't able to dodge it. Just heal through it.
During the fight he spawns 3x a mini max bot.  They despawn when Boldven dies
- 12. Speak with Firiona Vie 0/1 Grand Guild Hall
You say, 'Hail, Firiona Vie'
Firiona Vie catches her breath as she looks over the idol. 'You did very well in securing the [idol]. I am sorry that I was not able to get here in time to assist you in defeating the thief, but you appear to have handled the situation admirably.'
You say, 'idol'
Firiona Vie runs her hands across the surface. 'Yes, this is precisely what I needed, but now that I have it in my hands, I will need to do a little more research before I can utilize it effectively. For now, though, you have far exceeded my expectations. Thank you for all your help.'
Your task 'The Great Jade Idol Caper' has been updated.
Bonus item: Jade Crystal Sconce
Before opening the chest, look around the zone for crystal ground spawns.  Combine a blue and yellow crystal in the Jewelcrafting table in this mission to create a Jade Crystal Sconce.
- 13. Loot the chest 0/1 Grand Guild Hall
You can open the chest before everybody is in zone. You get the coin reward when you zone in.
You receive 41 platinum, 3 silver and 3 copper as your split (with a lucky bonus).
Your task 'The Great Jade Idol Caper' has been updated.
You have received a replay timer for 'The Great Jade Idol Caper': 0d:6h:0m:0s remaining.
After a messy teleport you and Firiona Vie were separated, but you managed to disable the hideout's remaining security and after confronting the thief, Boldven, you secured the idol for Firiona Vie.
You receive 5 silver .
You receive 2 gold .
You receive 2 platinum .

# 26th Anniversary: The Secret Sponsor

**Level:** 40 | **Maximum Level:** 130 | **Quest Type:** Adventure | **Repeatable:** Yes | **Monster Mission:** No


## Quest Text / Walkthrough

**Level:** 40
**Maximum Level:** 130
**Monster Mission:** No
**Repeatable:** Yes
**Can Be Shrouded?:** No
**Quest Type:** Adventure
**Time Limit:** 06:00:00
**Group Size:** Group
**Min. # of Players:** 1
**Max. # of Players:** 6

This shared heroic adventure can be obtained from Faeta Glor [npc=60518] in Shadeweaver's Thicket. He is on the Find tool (Ctrl+F).
You say, 'Hail, Faeta Glor'
Faeta Glor says, 'Welcome back to the gallery. Seems you are ready to meet the secret sponsor now. Would you like to go [find] them or would you like to look at the gallery [pieces]?'
You say, 'I`ll go find them.'
Faeta Glor says, 'The Doke Collective seemed to have also found out about the secret sponsor. I saw them heading there with some of the guards. You may run into them while searching for the sponsor. If you are [ready] just let me know and I will guide you to the entrance.'
You have been assigned the task 'The Secret Sponsor'.
You can now meet the secret sponsor. Hidden away in her lair what could they be doing. Time to venture forth and seek out what the sponsor has planned for figuring out their small riddle. Speak with Faeta Glor to enter the secret sponsor's lair.
- 1. Enter the secret sponsor's lair 0/1 Shadeweaver's Thicket
This updated for me at /way -649, 997, -224 at the mouth of the first tunnel you come to from the Loda Kai Embassy building where you zone into the instance.
- 2. Explore the cavern and seek out the sponsor 0/1 Shadeweaver's Thicket
This updated at /way -1339, 691, -429 heading south in the tunnel when you enter it from the west.
- 3. Jade statues have come to life destroy them 0/10 Shadeweaver's Thicket
Kill 10 of them, any of the civilians and criminals. They are level 120.
- 4. Fight through the Doke Collective's soldiers 0/10 Shadeweaver's Thicket
Not far away, a jade soldier, a jade spiriitist, a jade seer all count for this step. This includes the ones in the tunnels.  Kill 10 of them, they are level 120.
- 5. Explore deeper into the cavern to find out what is going on 0/1 Shadeweaver's Thicket
Go further south to /way -1738, 788, -420 until you see a series of holes.
- 6. Find what goes into the rock formation 0/1 Shadeweaver's Thicket
This updated for me at /way -2188, 1281, -427 in the far southern and west room in the tunnels.
- 7. Kill the Doke Collective 0/3 Shadeweaver's Thicket
Several mobs in the tunnels count for this. They have (Doke Collective) under their name. They are all level 126 but have very little hp.
Alaston Dianthus which is in the same room as the location update from the previous step.
Vileor Wilkern is in the room to the east of Alaston Dianthus.
Neetor Ikadiff is in the same room as Vileor.
- 8. Collect jade hearts 0/3 Shadeweaver's Thicket
They all drop Jade Heart, loot 3 of them.
- 9. Go back to the rock formation 0/1 Shadeweaver's Thicket
Go back to the a series of holes not far from the 2 rooms you were in.
- 10. Insert the 3 jade hearts into the rock formation 0/3 Shadeweaver's Thicket
Trade the 3 Jade Heart's to the a series of holes "NPC", click below the name to get a trade window. Or you can /target a_series
- 11. Enter the secret sponsor's abode 0/1 Shadeweaver's Thicket
This part is bugged, the rock was still there when I traded in the Jade Hearts to a series of holes. I was able to shrink twice, and then kept on ducking and unducking over and over again while walking forward in the cracks of the rock.
- 12. Enter the secret sponsor's abode 0/1 Shadeweaver's Thicket
This updates in the room behind where the big rock was at /way -1657, 1070, -434
- 13. Defeat the secret sponsor, Illia Forgor 0/1 Shadeweaver's Thicket
Illia Forgor is in the room back behind the rock. It's level 129 has the HP of a TOB rare.
It also casts Toxin Explosion, PB AE Unresistable, PBAE, Range 1000, AE Range 350. Duration 30 seconds. 47k to 50k damage per tick.
It also casts Slashing Strike. Unresistable, Single Target, Range 300. Pushback: 5, Push Up: 3. Duration 12 seconds.
It will push whoever has aggro the whole fight so the group will need to adjust as she pushes them.
Later in the fight when it gets below 50% it starts to cast Silencing Screech (Silence) PB AE, range 200, AE Range 25. Lasts for 12 seconds.
You gain party experience! (0.308%)
You have slain Ilia Forgor!
Your task 'The Secret Sponsor' has been updated.
My strat was to park the tank away from the group. Casters and healers keep their distance to avoid the silence, it's a short range on the silence. Heal through the dot.
- 14. Loot the chest 0/1 Shadeweaver's Thicket
You receive 18 platinum, 8 gold and 3 silver as your split.
Your task 'The Secret Sponsor' has been updated.
You have received a replay timer for 'The Secret Sponsor': 0d:6h:0m:0s remaining.
You found the secret sponsor, a gorgon by Ilia Forglor, and defeated them. On your way here you dispatched the Doke Collective, all the things they made you do were not humane anyways. You do not have a cure for the jade affliction, even if you wanted to spare any of them. Time to get out of this place.
You receive 5 silver .
You receive 2 gold .
You receive 2 platinum .
You received 10 Commemorative Coins.
Reward(s):
2 platinum 2 gold 5 silver
10 Commemorative Coins
Side Quest: When you kill Ilia Forgor, it spawns a note on the ground. Hand it to Faeta Glor in Shadeweaver's Thicket after zoning out of the instance to get Metamorph: Jade Sessiloid [item=151455].
Chest Loot:
Echo of Mastery
Girdle of Antiquity
Mark of Fury
